presets.title: Layered Cream Living
presets.summary: A generous open-plan room shaped by warm light and soft geometry.
presets.prompt: A wide frontal view of a large contemporary open-plan living room connected to a dark kitchen and bar area. The room has a high white ceiling with small recessed spotlights arranged in pairs. A large layered pendant lamp made of warm cream-colored horizontal fabric rings hangs in the center of the room.  On the left side, there are tall floor-to-ceiling windows covered with sheer white curtains and long dark taupe drapes. Next to the windows is a very large wall covered with bookmatched white marble slabs. The marble has dramatic dark gray and brown branching veins forming a symmetrical pattern in the center.  A large light gray modular sectional sofa fills the foreground and middle of the room. It has wide low seats, thick rectangular cushions, and many loose pillows in light gray, medium gray, and dark brown. A long dark brown upholstered section runs across the middle of the seating area. On the right is a separate pale gray chaise lounge with a dark gray leather pillow.  In front of the sofa are several low rectangular coffee table blocks made of very dark brown wood. Their flat surfaces hold a clear glass bowl, a small tray, and a short stack of black books. The seating area is placed on two large overlapping textured rugs in gray, charcoal, brown, and cream tones.  On the far right is a sculptural lounge chair with a thin bronze-colored metal wire frame, curved armrests, a light beige seat cushion, and a large beige back cushion. A small curved upholstered stool stands beside it.  The back wall and the right side of the room are covered in dark brown wood panels. The right wall includes a tall section of narrow vertical wooden slats and a dark doorway with a simple brass-colored handle. Behind the living room is a dark kitchen with black cabinets, reflective surfaces, open shelves, and a long island made of dark wood and black stone. Three compact bar stools stand around the island. A clear glass vase with leafy green branches sits on the counter.  Soft daylight enters from the left windows, while the pendant lamp and recessed ceiling lights create warm light in the center and background. The composition is balanced and spacious, with a neutral palette of gray, white marble, dark wood, black, beige, and warm brass.

presets.title: Sea Library Lounge
presets.summary: A long timber-lined retreat with books, sunken seating, and an ocean view.
presets.prompt: A wide interior view of a long modern living room with a library, a sunken seating area, and large windows facing the sea. The camera is positioned near one end of the room and looks diagonally toward a television and built-in shelves at the far end.  The ceiling is completely covered with medium brown wooden panels arranged in long rectangular sections. It slopes gently downward toward the far side of the room. Many small square recessed lights are placed in long organized rows across the wooden ceiling. Continuous soft white lighting runs along the edges where the ceiling meets the walls and windows.  The entire right wall is made of tall floor-to-ceiling windows. Outside the windows is a clear pale blue sky and a calm blue sea with a straight horizon. Long sheer white curtains hang beside the glass and allow bright daylight to enter the room.  The left wall is covered with tall white built-in bookshelves extending from the floor to the ceiling. The shelves contain books and a small number of decorative objects. More white shelving surrounds a large television at the far end of the room. The television displays a bright city street with modern buildings.  The floor is covered with wide warm brown wooden boards. Several wooden steps lead down into a lower conversation area near the center-left. The steps have clean straight edges and are integrated into the floor.  Multiple low sofas and built-in seating platforms are upholstered in white and very light gray fabric. A long sofa runs along the windows on the right. Another sofa sits in the middle of the room, and additional seating is arranged around the lower area near the television. The sofas have simple rectangular forms, wide seats, and loose cushions in white, light gray, and dark charcoal.  In the foreground are two smooth rounded triangular coffee tables in a pale cream color. One table holds an open silver laptop and two white cups with saucers. The second table holds an open architecture and design magazine. Both tables stand on a large soft white shag rug.  A small low rectangular cream table stands in front of the long window sofa and holds a cup, a glass of orange juice, and a small pastry. A small white circular side table with open shelves contains several books. A simple wooden ride-on toy with four wheels and a red handle stands in the middle of the room.  The room is bright and open, with warm wood on the ceiling and floor, white walls and furniture, soft cream tables, and cool blue light from the sea and sky. The long perspective emphasizes the depth of the room and the repeating lines of the ceiling lights, shelves, floorboards, and windows.

presets.title: Curved Color Salon
presets.summary: Rounded furniture and confident color give this eclectic room its rhythm.
presets.prompt: A frontal view of an eclectic contemporary living room with rounded furniture, bold colors, and a large abstract portrait. The room has pale warm gray walls, a light cream floor rug, and soft daylight entering through a tall window with sheer white curtains on the far left.  A tall matte black fireplace structure occupies the left-center part of the wall. It has a large simple rectangular upper section and a long low black horizontal base extending behind the furniture. Beside the fireplace is a tall translucent green vase holding a loose dark green branch.  A large framed abstract portrait hangs above the central sofa. The artwork shows a fragmented human face made from overlapping shapes in brown, black, beige, gray, muted blue, and dark green. It is placed inside a thin light wood frame with a pale background.  Below the artwork is a low white modular sofa with rounded segmented cushions. The backrest and seat are formed from repeated soft rectangular sections with curved edges. A folded plaid blanket in blue, red, gray, green, and brown is draped across the left side of the sofa.  In front of the sofa is a low round coffee table made of warm medium brown wood. It has a thick organic top and four short rounded legs. Several books and small objects are placed on its surface. Behind and to the right of it is a darker irregular stone coffee table with a black and gray surface and thin dark legs. Small decorative glass objects sit on top.  In the foreground is a large sculptural armchair upholstered in textured olive green fabric. It has thick rounded tubular arms, a curved back, and a deep seat. A second matching green chair is partially visible on the right edge. Between them is a small white pedestal side table with a round top and a thin curved base.  On the left is a large rounded cream lounge chair with horizontal padded sections. In front of it stands a small black sculptural stool with a rounded bowl-shaped top and four short legs. A black metal floor lamp with several curved bowl-shaped shades stands close to the window.  On the right side of the room is a rounded pod-shaped lounge chair with a dark reddish-brown outer shell and thick cream upholstery. A matching rounded cream ottoman with a brown shell is partially visible beside it.  Against the right wall is a bright blue open shelving system made from simple rectangular frames. It contains a few books, small sculptures, colorful decorative objects, and a low blue cabinet. The shelves are widely spaced and create a strong geometric contrast with the rounded furniture.  The room uses a mixed palette of cream, black, olive green, warm brown, bright blue, and muted colors from the artwork and blanket. The lighting is soft and natural, with gentle shadows and an evenly illuminated interior.

presets.title: Dark Timber Living
presets.summary: A cinematic contemporary room grounded by deep wood and low light.
presets.prompt: A wide front-facing view of a large dark contemporary living room. The composition is centered and almost symmetrical. The room has a flat ceiling covered with narrow dark brown wooden slats. Several long black ceiling beams run horizontally across the room, with small groups of round recessed lights built into them.  A tall floor-to-ceiling window fills the far left side. The window is covered with soft sheer white curtains and heavy dark brown curtains. Cool daylight enters from the left, making this side of the room brighter while the right side remains dark and shadowed.  The back wall is made from large vertical panels in charcoal gray and black. Some panels have a subtle dark stone pattern, while others have a fine vertical texture. The right wall is covered with large square dark gray panels.  A very large low modular sectional sofa fills most of the room. The sofa is upholstered in medium gray fabric and forms a wide U-shaped seating area. A large rectangular chaise extends toward the camera on the left, and another deep chaise extends toward the camera on the right. The sofa has broad armrests, deep seats, and many loose cushions in gray, taupe, and charcoal. Several small rectangular accent pillows are bright burnt orange. Dark gray blankets with thin orange edging are placed over both sides of the sofa. A soft gray blanket hangs over the right chaise and falls toward the floor.  Behind the sofa is a large vertical painting in warm brown, beige, black, and muted red tones. The painting shows a partially visible woman wearing a black sleeveless dress, leaning forward with her face lowered and partly hidden. The artwork is centered on the back wall.  A very thin suspended light hangs in front of the painting. Two long vertical cables descend from the ceiling and support a slim horizontal black metal bar with a warm light along its lower edge. The horizontal bar crosses the upper part of the painting.  In the center of the seating area is a low rectangular coffee table with a dark glass top and a black metal frame. The lower part of the table contains many thin diagonal metal rods crossing each other in an abstract pattern. On the table are a tall clear glass vase, a transparent glass bowl, and several small dark decorative objects.  An open book lies on the left chaise. A large muted gray and brown area rug sits under the sofa and coffee table. The floor around the rug is made from very dark brown wooden boards. The room has a quiet, moody atmosphere with charcoal walls, dark wood, gray furniture, warm orange accents, soft daylight from the left, and gentle warm light from the suspended lamp.

presets.title: Concrete Loft Glow
presets.summary: Raw concrete, dark furniture, and sculptural lamps meet bright glazing.
presets.prompt: A view of a minimalist contemporary loft living room with exposed concrete, warm wooden flooring, dark furniture, and large sculptural floor lamps. The camera is positioned near the front left side of the room and looks diagonally toward a bright floor-to-ceiling window on the right.  The ceiling is made from unfinished gray concrete with visible seams, patches, stains, and uneven texture. Several small black cylindrical ceiling lights are attached directly to the concrete. The wall on the far right is also raw gray concrete. The main back wall is smooth and painted in a soft warm beige-gray color.  A simple flush door is placed on the left side of the back wall. The door is the same color as the wall and has a small horizontal metal handle. Near the center of the wall is a large vertical abstract artwork. The upper part of the artwork is dark charcoal gray with a rough uneven texture, and the lower part is plain pale cream.  A large low modular sofa occupies the center and right side of the room. The sofa is upholstered in very dark brown fabric and has wide deep seats, soft rounded edges, and several large loose back cushions. It forms an L-shaped arrangement, with a long section running along the bright window and a large chaise extending toward the camera on the right. Dark brown and black cushions rest against the back of the sofa.  A low black oval coffee table stands in front of the sofa. It has a thin top and simple angled legs. An open dark laptop is placed on the table. The table and sofa stand on a large rectangular rug with a worn abstract pattern in dark blue, gray, black, and muted beige.  The floor is covered with wide wooden boards in mixed warm brown and gray-brown tones. The boards have visible natural grain and slightly different shades.  A very tall floor lamp stands near the bright window. It has three long thin black rods rising at different angles, each ending in a small black cylindrical lamp head. Two additional sculptural floor lamps have long curved black metal arms and large glowing shades shaped like open flowers. Each shade is made from several overlapping oval petals of woven golden-brown material with dark edging. Warm bulbs are visible in the center of the shades. One flower-shaped lamp stands behind the middle of the sofa, and a larger one is positioned in the foreground on the right.  The floor-to-ceiling window on the right is extremely bright and covered with soft translucent white material, creating diffused white daylight. The window light creates strong contrast between the bright right side and the darker interior. The flower-shaped lamps add warm golden light around the sofa. The room has a quiet evening atmosphere with raw concrete, dark brown furniture, warm wood, soft beige walls, and glowing woven lamps.

presets.title: Copper Disc Lamp
presets.summary: A restrained material study of concrete, muted upholstery, and warm copper light.
presets.prompt: A simple close interior view of a modern floor lamp standing beside the left portion of a low upholstered lounge chair. The composition is minimal, with the chair cropped by the left edge and the floor lamp placed slightly right of center.  The background is a large unfinished gray concrete wall. The wall has a rough surface with small holes, faint vertical marks, subtle horizontal seams, and uneven gray tones. Soft shadows from the lamp fall onto the wall on the right.  The floor is made from dark gray-brown wooden boards with visible grain and narrow seams. A small part of a woven gray rug enters from the lower left corner.  The lounge chair on the left has a wide low seat upholstered in muted sage green and gray-green textured fabric. It has a slim rounded armrest and a soft dark olive green back cushion. A large square gray-green pillow rests against the back. A coral pink square pillow is partially visible at the far left. The chair stands on thin dark bronze-colored metal legs.  The floor lamp has a flat round black base and a tall narrow cylindrical lower body. A thin vertical dark metal rod rises from the base. Four circular disc-shaped lamp heads are attached near the upper half of the rod in two pairs.  The upper pair contains a dark matte circular disc facing the camera and a second warm copper-colored circular disc placed behind it and slightly to the right. The lower pair contains another dark matte disc facing forward and a glowing copper-colored disc behind it and slightly to the left. The copper interiors produce a soft warm orange light around their edges. The dark front discs remain almost black and create a strong contrast with the warm light behind them.  The lamp is tall, thin, and geometric, while the chair is soft and rounded. The scene uses a restrained palette of concrete gray, dark metal, muted green, dark olive, warm copper, and one small coral pink accent. The lighting is dim and soft, with gentle warm highlights from the lamp and subtle shadows on the concrete wall.

presets.title: Geometric Fireside
presets.summary: Paired chairs and artful screens frame an intimate modern hearth.
presets.prompt: A front-facing view of an elegant contemporary sitting area arranged around a compact fireplace. The composition is nearly symmetrical, with two matching armchairs placed on both sides of the fireplace and turned slightly toward the center.  The fireplace is positioned in the middle of the back wall. It has a wide rectangular surround made from pale gray stone with fine horizontal texture. A dark glass firebox is built into the center, with natural logs visible inside. The fireplace mantel is simple, thick, and rectangular.  Above the fireplace hangs a very large rectangular mirror in a thin warm gold frame. The mirror extends almost to the ceiling. It reflects another room behind the camera, including a ceiling light with several frosted glass shades, a second rectangular mirror, warm wooden wall panels, shelving, and a large blue rectangular artwork.  A small stack of dark books sits on the left side of the mantel. A simple framed white artwork with a very small central drawing rests on the right side.  Two matching lounge chairs stand in front of the fireplace. They have tall gently curved backs, rounded armrests, thin dark metal legs, and light blue-gray upholstery covered with a small repeating geometric pattern. The chairs face slightly inward toward a small side table placed between them.  The side table has a narrow polished brass pedestal base and a small round dark green top with a gold edge. A second low decorative bowl with a dark green interior and a gold rim is partially visible in the foreground.  Behind each armchair stands a tall decorative folding screen made from large irregular geometric panels. The screens combine light natural wood, cream, deep burgundy red, dark blue, gray, black, and reflective gold accents. Thin gold-colored lines separate the angular panels.  The screen on the right contains a large circular wall light placed over a cream-colored section. The light glows with a soft warm yellow tone. The screen continues toward the right edge of the room, where darker mirrored and geometric surfaces are visible.  On the left side, floor-to-ceiling beige curtains cover a tall window. In front of the curtains is a large white stone pedestal. A textured translucent white vase stands on top of it, filled with many tall thin branches covered in small pale yellow flowers. The branches spread widely and extend above the armchairs.  The lower part of the room contains a blue-green area rug with subtle tonal variation. A small portion of a pale cream chair appears in the lower left corner, while books and decorative objects are partially visible along the lower edge. The room uses pale stone, light blue fabric, warm gold metal, natural wood, burgundy, navy blue, and soft yellow accents.

presets.title: Forest Mural Hall
presets.summary: A grand vaulted interior opens onto a monumental painted forest.
presets.prompt: A centered view of a grand double-height living hall with classical white architecture and an enormous arched forest mural covering the far wall. The room is tall, symmetrical, bright, and spacious.  The ceiling forms a large white barrel vault made from several wide concentric arches. The arches contain layered moldings, recessed panels, and delicate ornamental details. The upper side walls have a sequence of tall arched windows that allow daylight to enter from both sides.  The lower side walls are decorated with white classical wall panels, carved floral details, narrow pilasters, arches, and ornamental molding. The bottom section of the walls is covered with dark charcoal-gray paneling, creating a strong contrast with the white architecture above.  The far wall is almost completely covered by a monumental arched landscape mural. The mural shows a quiet forest with very tall old trees, thick trunks, spreading green branches, and dense foliage. A shallow rocky stream flows through the lower part of the landscape. The center opens toward a distant hazy valley filled with soft golden light. The forest uses muted green, olive, brown, gray, and warm beige tones.  Several large indoor plants stand in front of the mural. There are leafy trees in black cylindrical planters, a rounded plant in a textured brown pot on the left, and additional green plants in pale stone-colored pots on the right.  A long dining table is placed directly in front of the mural. The table has a pale stone or glass top supported by polished gold-colored metal legs. Several slim dining chairs with circular gold frames are arranged around it. Clear glasses, plates, bottles, and small table settings are distributed across the tabletop.  In the foreground is a large low modular sectional sofa upholstered in pale cream textured fabric. It forms a wide U-shaped arrangement. Long chaise sections extend toward the camera on both the left and right sides. The sofa has wide rectangular seats, clean straight edges, low backrests, and many square cream cushions. Thin polished gold details are visible along the sofa base and outer corners.  The sectional stands on a large olive-green rug. A bold black-and-white geometric pattern appears beneath and behind the sofa, forming horizontal lines, irregular blocks, and striped shapes.  A large rectangular coffee table sits in the center of the rug. It is made from deep green stone with visible natural veining. A wide irregular horizontal band of polished gold-colored material runs through the middle of the table base. Two small abstract gold sculptures and a short stack of black-and-white books rest on the tabletop.  On the far left is a small round black side table holding a dark sculptural table lamp with a wide black shade and a faceted base. Strong daylight enters from the left windows and creates long diagonal shadows across the green rug and pale wooden floor. The room combines formal white architecture, dark wall panels, green forest imagery, pale cream furniture, deep green stone, and polished gold accents.

presets.title: Teal Conversation Bar
presets.summary: Deep paneling and balanced cabinetry create a jewel-box gathering room.
presets.prompt: A centered view of an intimate home bar and conversation room covered in deep teal wall paneling. The composition is symmetrical, with two built-in bar cabinets on both sides of a large central doorway.  The walls and ceiling are painted in a rich dark teal color. Decorative rectangular molding covers the walls, cabinetry, ceiling edges, and ceiling panels. The floor is made from medium brown wooden boards and is partly covered by a muted blue and gray patterned rug.  A large brass chandelier hangs in the center of the ceiling. It has a vertical central stem, several curved brass arms, and multiple small white tapered fabric shades arranged at different heights.  The central doorway has a thick teal frame and opens into a much brighter cream-colored room. Through the opening, a pale staircase is visible on the left. At the back is an arched doorway with two warm wooden doors opened outward. Beyond the doors is a small seating or sleeping area with pale upholstery and a framed picture. A cream sofa, light cushions, small wall lamps, and leafy plants are also visible in the adjoining room.  On both sides of the central doorway are tall built-in bar cabinets with reflective mirrored backs. The left cabinet contains many rows of clear glasses, stemware, bottles, metal cups, books, and small bar accessories. The right cabinet contains bottles arranged along the upper shelves, hanging wine glasses, more glassware, flowers, and decorative objects. The mirrored surfaces reflect the shelves and create a dense pattern of glass and light.  Below both bar displays are dark teal cabinets and drawers. The cabinet doors have fine vertical grooves and small polished brass handles. The larger lower cabinet on the right has two long vertical brass handles.  A horizontal brass picture light is mounted above each bar cabinet. The warm metal lights contrast with the dark teal wall.  Four large lounge chairs are arranged in a circle in the foreground. They are upholstered in deep navy blue velvet and have high curved backs, rounded sides, wide seats, and soft sculptural arms. Two chairs are seen from the front, while two chairs in the foreground are viewed from behind.  At the center of the four chairs is a large round ottoman upholstered in warm caramel-brown leather. Its surface is smooth and softly padded. A wide shallow glass bowl rests on top, holding a clear vase with long branches and large green and brown leaves.  To the left of the seating group is a small round side table with a dark top and thin metal base. Several books are stacked on it, together with a silver-colored decorative bowl and small objects.  A tall window is positioned on the left wall. It has a dark teal frame and two large pale panes filled with diffused daylight. The light from the window softly illuminates the left side of the chairs, while the bar cabinets and corners remain darker. The room uses deep teal, navy velvet, warm brown leather, cream, dark wood, mirrored glass, and brass details.

presets.title: Double-Height Dining
presets.summary: A tall wood-lined dining space composed for dramatic vertical scale.
presets.prompt: A tall elegant double-height dining area with a modern luxury style. The room has very high ceilings and a dramatic vertical composition. The left wall is covered in large warm brown wood panels with visible grain, divided into clean rectangular sections. Above, a black metal mezzanine or upper-level railing runs along the top left side.  Mounted on the wooden wall is a framed abstract painting with soft cream, pale blue, gray, and beige tones. The painting is vertically oriented and placed above a row of dining chairs.  At the center of the room stands a round black dining table with a glossy surface and a sculptural metallic pedestal base in warm brass or bronze. A small floral arrangement sits on the table in a vase.  Around the table are six upholstered dining chairs in a soft beige or taupe color. The chairs have rounded backs, smooth curved seats, slim dark legs, and small metallic caps at the feet.  Above the table hang two very tall cylindrical crystal chandeliers. Each chandelier is made of many sparkling crystal strands forming a long tapered vertical shape. They hang from black ceiling rods and glow with bright white light, becoming the main focal point of the space.  Behind the chandeliers are very tall dark gray curtains hanging from near the ceiling down to the lower level. Large black-framed windows rise behind the curtains and bring in soft daylight. Through a lower window, parts of nearby city buildings are visible.  The right side of the room features light walls with decorative panel molding and vertical black slatted details near the center. A modern wall sconce with layered glowing elements is mounted on the right wall.  The floor is polished white marble with subtle gray veining, reflecting the light from the chandeliers and the furniture. The overall palette is warm wood, black metal, soft beige upholstery, white marble, and crystal light, creating a refined and spacious atmosphere.

presets.title: Vaulted Rustic Living
presets.summary: Soft white rafters and warm furnishings refresh a classic country room.
presets.prompt: A wide front-facing view of a warm rustic living room with a high vaulted ceiling. The ceiling is painted soft white and supported by large white beams, angled rafters, and decorative curved brackets. A dark metal starburst chandelier is partially visible at the top center.  The walls are painted a muted warm beige. Three tall black-framed windows bring natural daylight into the room. The central window is placed directly behind the sofa, while additional windows appear on the far left and beside the fireplace on the right. The windows are framed by long beige curtains with a small repeating pattern. Green trees are visible outside.  Two tall white built-in bookcases stand on both sides of the central window. The shelves are filled with books arranged horizontally and vertically, small framed objects, baskets, and decorative pieces. Several large ceramic vessels in dark brown, tan, cream, and reddish-brown are displayed along the tops of the bookcases.  A medium-sized white upholstered sofa stands in the center of the room. It has rounded arms, a single wide seat cushion, and a softly curved back. Two pale beige square pillows and one long dark brown textured pillow are arranged across the sofa.  On the left side are two wooden lounge chairs placed at an angle. They have dark brown wooden frames, woven cane backs and seats, broad curved armrests, and loose cream seat cushions. A woven basket sits between the chairs and the sofa. A tall slim floor lamp with a simple beige fabric shade stands behind the left side of the sofa.  Behind the chairs is a tall dark wooden cabinet. A large round black planter sits on top of it, holding a broad tropical plant with long dark green leaves.  In front of the sofa is a group of overlapping low coffee tables. The left table has an irregular natural edge and a marbled brown, cream, and gray surface. It holds a dark round ceramic vase, a closed book, and a small decorative object. Behind it is a long dark oval table holding a tall ceramic vessel, a black cylindrical candle, and a small green object. On the right is a low dark gray table with rounded corners and a shallow terracotta-colored bowl.  A dark wooden side table stands to the right of the sofa. It holds a tall table lamp with a wide cylindrical beige shade, a pale sculptural lamp base, and several decorative bottles. A light neutral rug with a subtle geometric pattern covers the center of the floor.  The right wall contains a large fireplace made from irregular dark gray, brown, and rust-colored stones. The fireplace opening is deep and black, with a heavy stone mantel above it. A large sculptural arrangement of natural antlers is mounted over the mantel. Several cream pillar candles sit in black holders among the antlers. A small low wooden folding stool stands near the fireplace.  The room combines white painted wood, beige walls, dark natural timber, rough stone, woven cane, neutral fabric, pottery, books, and many green plants. Bright natural daylight creates soft shadows and a comfortable, lived-in atmosphere.

presets.title: Glass Corner Penthouse
presets.summary: A broad glass corner turns a layered lounge toward the evening skyline.
presets.prompt: A wide view of a large contemporary penthouse living room at dusk. The room is surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass windows with thin black metal frames. The windows cover the entire back wall and continue along the right side, forming a glass corner.  Outside the windows is a wide city skyline filled with many small glowing lights. Tall buildings rise in the distance, with a slender illuminated tower near the center. Dark blue mountain shapes and large clouds stretch across the horizon beneath a pale blue and pink evening sky.  The ceiling is flat and dark charcoal gray. Small black recessed spotlights are arranged across it. A continuous strip of warm yellow light follows the ceiling edges above the windows and creates a glowing frame around the room.  The left wall is covered by a large built-in shelving system made from dark warm wood and black metal. The shelves extend from the floor almost to the ceiling and are filled with many books, small sculptures, dark ceramic vessels, framed objects, and stacked magazines. Warm linear lights are built beneath several shelves, illuminating the books and creating horizontal bands of golden light.  A large low sectional sofa occupies the center of the room. It is upholstered in pale beige fabric and forms a broad L-shaped seating arrangement. A deep chaise extends toward the camera on the left. The sofa has wide low seats, thick back cushions, and many loose pillows in cream, beige, taupe, dark gray, black, and muted burnt orange. A folded dark blanket rests on the foreground chaise.  The sofa stands on a very large rectangular rug in pale cream and warm light beige. The rug covers most of the central floor area. Dark brown wooden floorboards remain visible around the edges.  Several low rectangular coffee tables are layered in front of the sofa. They have thin black metal frames and tops in dark brown, black, and pale cream. The tables hold stacks of books, a small white ceramic vessel, a dark decorative bowl, a glass vase with thin branches, and several small objects. A small round side table with a white top and thin black frame stands near the right side of the sofa.  Tall heavy curtains in dark brown and taupe hang in the back left corner beside the windows. Near the center-right window is a slender black floor lamp with a long angled arm and a small dark shade.  Large square planters stand beside the glass walls and on the terrace outside. They contain small rounded trees and dense green plants. The plants appear as dark silhouettes against the blue evening sky and city lights.  The interior is illuminated by warm shelf lighting, soft ceiling lights, and the glowing strip around the ceiling. The outdoor light is cool blue, creating a strong contrast between the warm interior and the evening city view. The room uses pale beige upholstery, dark wood, black metal, cream textiles, warm amber light, and cool blue tones from the windows.

presets.title: Cobalt Pattern Salon
presets.summary: Saturated blue, patterned textiles, and classical detail form a vivid salon.
presets.prompt: A wide front-facing view of a richly decorated living room with deep saturated blue walls, blue furniture, colorful patterns, and a nearly symmetrical composition.  The walls are painted a strong cobalt blue and covered with classical rectangular panel molding. Wide blue crown molding runs around the top of the room. The ceiling is covered with a dramatic flowing pattern of dark blue, turquoise, pale blue, white, and black curved lines, similar to layered stone or flowing waves. A large white hanging light made from many vertical translucent pieces is partially visible at the top center.  Two tall white-framed windows are positioned on the back wall, one on each side of a large central artwork. Both windows have blue Roman shades lowered over their upper sections. A narrow dark red trim runs along the lower edge of each shade. Trees and soft daylight are visible through the window panes.  A large rectangular abstract painting hangs in the center of the wall inside a wide white frame. The artwork contains loose layered marks in coral red, pale pink, white, mint green, yellow, turquoise, and dark green.  Directly below the artwork is a long low sofa upholstered in deep blue velvet. The sofa has a simple straight back, narrow arms, slim dark legs, and thin red piping along the seat and lower edge. Two large blue pillows stand at the outer corners. Two square coral-red pillows with blue borders sit closer to the center. A smaller rectangular pillow with a repeating geometric pattern in red, green, white, and black is placed in the middle.  On the left are two matching lounge chairs upholstered in a dense multicolored botanical fabric. The fabric contains green leaves, flowers, birds, and animal shapes in emerald green, turquoise, red, orange, yellow, and black. One chair is fully visible beside the sofa, while the second is cropped by the lower left edge. The chairs have rounded backs, curved arms, thick seat cushions, and dark wooden legs.  On the right are two glossy black-framed lounge chairs with open curved armrests and small metallic details. Their seat and back cushions are upholstered in pale yellow-green fabric with an irregular dark navy or black animal-like pattern. One chair stands beside the sofa, and another is cropped by the lower right edge. A matching round ottoman with the same patterned upholstery sits in the foreground.  A long oval coffee table stands in front of the sofa. It has a clear glass top and a thin bamboo-like frame in aged brass. The lower supports cross beneath the glass in a geometric arrangement. On the table is a clear cylindrical vase filled with a large loose arrangement of bright green flowers and leaves. Several stacked books, small decorative boxes, a dark bowl, and other small objects are arranged around the vase.  A pale blue-gray rug lies beneath the seating group. Warm wooden parquet flooring in a herringbone pattern remains visible around the rug.  To the left of the sofa is a round dark wood side table. It holds several coral-colored books and a tall lamp with an olive-green ceramic base and a large pleated black shade. A small metallic side table with a round top stands beside the floral chair.  On the far left wall is a polished silver half-sphere planter filled with small green plants. A small dark circular wall object hangs below it.  To the right of the sofa is a narrow black console table beneath the window. It holds a black table lamp with a warm gold sculptural base, clear drinking glasses, amber-colored containers, a silver tray, and a small white architectural object. A small framed painting in a warm gold frame hangs on the wall nearby.  The far-right window is covered by long heavy blue curtains with a narrow red inner edge. Bright natural daylight enters from the windows and creates clear highlights on the velvet, glass, polished metal, and lacquered furniture. The room is dominated by cobalt blue, with coral red, olive green, brass, black, white, and multicolored botanical accents.

presets.title: Olive Arch Bath
presets.summary: Rounded green arches frame a richly decorated marble bathroom.
presets.prompt: A centered view into a large decorative bathroom framed by olive-green columns and rounded arches. The room combines classical architectural details, patterned wallpaper, white marble, colorful artwork, brass lighting, and many green tones.  The main architectural structure is painted in a muted yellow-green olive color. Tall fluted columns with decorative capitals stand on both sides of the opening. Additional smaller columns continue deeper into the room. Thick rounded arches connect the columns beneath a ceiling with rectangular molding, layered trim, and decorative borders.  Two large hanging lanterns are aligned through the center of the room. Each lantern has a clear spherical glass body surrounded by warm brass bands, small circular metal decorations, a decorative upper crown, and a pointed lower finial. Bright warm bulbs glow inside the glass. The nearest lantern is larger, while the second hangs farther back above the bathtub.  A white freestanding bathtub is positioned in the center of the back room. It has a long oval shape, smooth rounded sides, and a polished silver faucet placed along its back edge. A dark upholstered stool or chair is partially visible to the right of the tub.  The wall behind the bathtub contains built-in shelving painted the same olive green as the columns. The shelves are filled with books, folded white towels, small vessels, framed objects, and decorative pieces. Two colorful figure paintings hang among the shelves. The larger painting has a warm gold frame and shows a dark figure against a bright yellow and orange background. The smaller painting beside it contains a stylized face in red, dark brown, green, and black.  On the left side of the bathroom is a tall wall covered with large white marble slabs. Fine gray veins move diagonally across the marble. A white wall-mounted sink with a polished silver faucet is placed against this surface. A white hand towel hangs from a simple metal rail beside the sink.  A warm wall light is mounted on the marble. It is made from a bundle of thin gold-colored rods pulled together at the center, producing light from both ends.  The side walls around the entrance are covered with detailed illustrated wallpaper on a pale cream background. The wallpaper shows trees with green and dark teal foliage, magenta and burgundy plants, rocky ground, birds, deer, a resting lion, and other animals in a continuous landscape scene. A matching bundled gold wall light is mounted over the wallpaper on the right.  A very large indoor plant fills much of the right foreground. It has broad dark green leaves with strong pale veins and stands inside a large white planter. The leaves overlap the wallpaper and partly hide the right side of the room.  On the left foreground is a small round side table with a slim brass pedestal and a pale stone top. The table holds a tall white folded or pleated vase filled with deep red branches and small flowers. A small decorative face-shaped object stands beside it.  The floor is covered with a repeating geometric pattern made from large white octagons, smaller central shapes, and thin beige or gray outlines. The pattern continues from the foreground into the bathtub area.  The composition looks through several layers of arches and columns, creating a clear view toward the central bathtub and bookshelves. Warm light from the brass lanterns and wall sconces mixes with soft white light from the ceiling. The palette includes olive green, warm brass, white marble, cream, dark green leaves, magenta, yellow, black, and small areas of bright color from the paintings.

presets.title: Sculptural Leather Circle
presets.summary: Four generous leather chairs anchor a bright eclectic conversation room.
presets.prompt: A wide view of a bright eclectic conversation room with four large sculptural brown leather chairs arranged around a small central table. The room has white walls, a pale blue ceiling, warm wooden flooring, colorful artwork, patterned wallpaper, and large tropical plants.  Four matching lounge chairs form a close circular seating arrangement in the foreground. The chairs are upholstered in smooth medium brown leather with subtle reddish tones. Each chair has a deep curved seat, a rounded back that folds inward, and very wide side panels that flow down toward the floor. The forms are soft, heavy, and sculptural, with almost no visible legs.  The two rear chairs face the camera, while the two foreground chairs are seen mostly from behind and from the side. The four chairs surround a small square coffee table. The table is covered with narrow vertical black-and-white stripes and stands on thin dark legs.  A round brass tray is placed on top of the striped table. The tray holds a metallic bowl filled with a loose flower arrangement. The arrangement includes dark blue flowers, orange and coral blossoms, thin branching greenery, long leaves, and small hanging plant shapes.  The seating group stands on a large area rug. The central section beneath the chairs is deep teal blue. The right side of the rug is pale cream and decorated with scattered short lines and small marks in red, blue, black, yellow, and green. A small part of a red upholstered seat is visible in the lower right corner.  The floor around the rug is made from wide light brown wooden boards with visible natural grain.  A large brass starburst chandelier hangs from the center of the pale blue ceiling. It has a small central sphere surrounded by many straight rectangular brass rods spreading outward in all directions. A thin black line runs around the upper edge of the white walls.  On the left wall hangs a small framed picture with a wide black frame and a pale inner border. The artwork shows a small seated figure against vertical beige and green stripes.  Below the picture is a red dispenser cabinet mounted on a tall black pedestal. It contains three separate transparent compartments with red frames, silver triangular lower sections, and small handles.  The back wall contains three tall narrow interior window openings with white frames. Through the openings is another bright room with large green plants, pale walls, windows, and a ceiling light made from several small glowing spheres on branching arms.  To the right of the interior windows is a short dividing wall covered with white wallpaper and a repeating black botanical pattern. The pattern consists of many small detailed tree or plant shapes arranged in rows.  A large colorful artwork hangs on the patterned wall. The artwork is divided into several vertical panels and contains abstract faces, angular shapes, and curved lines in coral pink, pale blue, black, red, yellow, green, white, and purple.  Below the artwork stands a low dark brown wooden cabinet with a ribbed front. Small decorative objects and plants are placed on top. A bright green sculptural chair is partially visible beside the cabinet. An orange or coral-colored doorway appears farther back on the right.  The far-right wall contains a large full-height glass door in a white frame. Through the glass is a tall tropical plant with broad pale green leaves standing in a white planter with narrow dark vertical stripes. Bright daylight enters through the door and illuminates the right side of the chairs and wooden floor.  The room combines smooth brown leather, black-and-white stripes, deep teal fabric, light wood, white walls, black botanical patterns, colorful artwork, green plants, red details, and warm brass metal. The light is clear and natural, with soft shadows beneath the furniture and bright reflections on the leather and brass.

presets.title: Charcoal Portrait Dining
presets.summary: Pattern, portraiture, and a long polished table animate a dark dining room.
presets.prompt: A vertical front-facing view of a dark dining room with a long rectangular table placed in the center. The room has a deep charcoal and black color palette, with warm sunlight entering from the left and creating bright patches across the floor, rug, chairs, and tabletop.  The ceiling is painted very dark charcoal gray and divided by wide raised beams and layered decorative molding. The ceiling and crown molding have a slightly glossy surface. A large modern chandelier hangs above the dining table. It has a slim brass central stem, many long thin black arms spreading outward, and several small black cone-shaped shades pointing in different directions.  The upper part of the walls is covered with cream wallpaper printed with dense irregular black splashes and rough ink-like marks. The lower part of the walls is covered with dark charcoal wood paneling. The wall trim, door frames, and baseboards are also painted dark charcoal.  A large framed portrait hangs in the center of the back wall. The artwork shows a dark-skinned man standing and holding a long staff. He wears a pale blue sleeveless top and is placed against a bright background filled with pink, coral, red, and green plant shapes. The picture has a wide white border and a thick warm wood frame.  To the left of the portrait is a tall doorway with a heavy dark frame and narrow textured glass panels. On the left wall is a small crescent-shaped decorative object with a face. A tall red sculptural floor light stands near the doorway. It is made from several angled red poles ending in round cream-colored bulbs.  A long polished brown wooden dining table runs from the foreground toward the back wall. The table has a smooth reflective top, softly rounded corners, and thick curved wooden legs. A blue-gray patterned runner covers the middle section of the table.  Several slender dining chairs are arranged along both sides. The chairs have thin black metal frames, dark seats, and open rectangular backs with dark woven or perforated panels. The chairs are placed close together and face the table.  The table is set with deep blue bowls, plates, clear drinking glasses, dark serving bowls, and small decorative objects. A large clear glass vase stands near the middle, filled with a loose arrangement of green branches, yellow flowers, broad leaves, and small berries. Two smooth reflective silver sculptural objects stand behind the vase.  A large mustard-yellow rug covers most of the floor beneath the dining table. The rug has a green border and delicate branching botanical patterns in dark brown, blue, purple, red, and pale green. The surrounding floor is made from dark brown wooden boards.  On the right side of the room are several low rounded lounge chairs with dark glossy surfaces. One chair has a curved black leather seat, while another has a smooth metallic bronze-gray body. A narrow vertical wall section at the far right is covered with small rectangular tiles in dark blue, burgundy, brown, and muted gold.  Strong natural light enters from the left side and falls diagonally across the yellow rug. The back and right sides remain darker, creating a strong contrast between the warm sunlight, colorful rug, patterned wallpaper, and deep charcoal architectural details.

presets.title: Mustard Fern Bedroom
presets.summary: Botanical wallpaper wraps a warm bedroom in graphic continuity.
presets.prompt: A bright bedroom viewed from the foot and left side of the bed. The room is covered with mustard-yellow wallpaper printed with a repeating pattern of thin pale green fern branches. The same botanical pattern continues across all visible walls, around the doorway, and over the ceiling.  A large bed fills the right side and foreground. The bed has a tall rounded headboard upholstered in warm burnt orange fabric. The matching orange platform base has clean straight sides and a long cream fringe hanging along the entire lower edge.  The bed is made with smooth white sheets and large white pillows. A beige coverlet with a small repeating brown geometric pattern covers most of the mattress. A colorful folded blanket lies across the lower half of the bed. The blanket has a dense ornamental pattern of large floral medallions and curling leaves in cobalt blue, pale blue, orange, red, cream, and golden yellow.  Several decorative pillows rest against the orange headboard. They are covered with detailed botanical fabric showing blue and red flowers, green stems, small birds, leaves, and fine decorative borders. The pillows have narrow reddish-brown trim around their edges.  A small bedside table stands beside the headboard. A polished brass lamp with a wide rounded dome shade sits on the table. A small vase of white flowers and a few small objects are placed beneath the lamp. On the far right edge is another small table made from pale burled wood, with a shallow brass bowl on top. A short stack of colorful books is visible near the floor.  The floor is covered with a muted teal-blue carpet. The carpet has a repeating pattern of small white flower and diamond shapes arranged in straight rows.  On the left side of the room stands a large woven rattan chair. It has a tall rounded open back formed by curved cane lines, a circular woven base, and a pale pink seat cushion. A small rectangular pillow in light pink fabric with a delicate vertical pattern rests against the back.  Behind the chair is an open doorway framed with the same yellow fern wallpaper. A dark gray paneled door is opened inward, revealing part of a brighter adjoining room with pale walls.  A small square framed artwork hangs on the back wall between the doorway and the bed. It contains a symmetrical flower or plant design in dark red, orange, blue, green, and cream inside a pale frame.  The room is filled with clear natural light. The palette is dominated by mustard yellow, fern green, burnt orange, cobalt blue, white, pale pink, teal, and warm brass.

presets.title: Orange Jungle Lounge
presets.summary: An orange sectional and tropical pattern fill a compact room with energy.
presets.prompt: A vertical view of a colorful living room with an orange velvet sectional sofa, tropical leaf wallpaper, many patterned cushions, and a large framed artwork. The room feels compact and full, with furniture and decorative objects placed close together.  The walls are completely covered with wallpaper showing overlapping tropical leaves. Large palm, fern, banana, and split-leaf shapes appear in dark forest green, black, and muted green against a pale cream and soft pink background. The pattern continues around the corner onto the right wall.  A long horizontal clerestory window runs across the upper part of the back wall. The window has a thin dark frame and shows dense outdoor greenery, tall palm leaves, branches, and pale tree trunks. The ceiling above is smooth and white, with a slightly angled shape.  A large L-shaped sectional sofa fills the lower half of the room. It is upholstered in rich burnt orange velvet. One long section runs across the back wall, while the second section extends toward the foreground on the right. The sofa has deep seats, broad cushions, low arms, and a soft velvety surface.  Many decorative pillows are arranged across the sofa. They include burnt orange velvet pillows, pale blue-gray pillows, black pillows with orange floral designs, cream pillows with brown zigzag lines, leopard-patterned pillows in cream and dark brown, bright geometric pillows in turquoise, orange, black, and white, and square pillows with circular ornamental designs in pink, green, yellow, white, and blue.  A large framed artwork hangs above the center of the sofa. It shows a person viewed from behind, wearing a long bright red robe with white lettering across the back. The figure has a large dark blue and green wrapped hairstyle and carries a large black oval object under one arm. The background contains narrow vertical stripes in turquoise and red, while the floor has matching diagonal stripes. A border of small orange rectangular pictures surrounds the image, followed by a wide white frame.  On the far left is a small round side table with a painted cylindrical base decorated in red, green, black, and gold patterns. A sculptural green lamp stands on the table beneath a simple black cylindrical shade. A small section of a dark window or doorway is visible behind it.  On the right wall is a tall decorative bird sculpture. It has a dark elongated wooden body, a curved tail, and a brightly colored head in red, yellow, blue, and green.  In the foreground is a round sculptural coffee table. Its base is formed from wide woven rope sections arranged like flower petals. The sections alternate between mustard yellow and cream white. A round natural wood top sits above the woven base.  A clear green glass vase stands on the coffee table, filled with orange pincushion-shaped flowers, small green branches, and loose leaves. A small dark green dish holding a few pale objects sits beside the vase.  Several layered rugs cover the floor. One rug has a traditional pattern in dark red, blue, cream, and muted orange. Another has a brown woven center with narrow patterned borders. A dark textile with large bright blue tassels enters the lower right foreground.  Natural daylight enters through the high window and illuminates the wallpaper, orange velvet, plants, artwork, and patterned fabrics. The main colors are burnt orange, dark green, cream, black, turquoise, red, mustard yellow, blue, and pale pink.

presets.title: Midnight Library
presets.summary: Glossy navy millwork turns a quiet home study into a deep-toned retreat.
presets.prompt: A wide straight-on view of a dark home library and study. The walls, ceiling, built-in shelves, and cabinets are painted in deep glossy navy blue. The ceiling has large rectangular raised panels and reflects small areas of light.  Tall black-framed glass doors fill the left side of the room. Pale daylight enters through the glass and reveals part of a light-colored exterior balcony and building facade outside.  Near the left side of the back wall is a pair of tall dark brown wooden doors. Each door is decorated with three large geometric panels made from angular pieces of wood, forming raised faceted diamond shapes. The doors have warm brass hinges and long vertical brass handles.  The center of the back wall is covered with floor-to-ceiling built-in bookshelves painted the same dark navy blue as the room. The shelves are divided into several tall vertical sections. Thin warm lights run beneath the shelves, and small brass picture lights are mounted along the top.  The shelves are filled with books arranged both vertically and horizontally. Many books have black, dark blue, pale blue, coral, and red covers. Decorative objects are placed between them, including a framed black-and-white picture, a small dark sculpture, a white sculpted bust, pale coral-like objects, stone pieces, boxes, and small gold animal figures.  The entire right wall is covered with tall closed cabinets and raised rectangular wall panels. Small square brass handles are evenly placed across the cabinet doors and drawers.  A large dark writing desk stands in the middle of the room. It has a glossy rectangular top, thick turned black legs, and decorative horizontal supports connecting the legs. The polished surface reflects the objects placed on it.  A long adjustable brass desk lamp stretches across the tabletop. It has thin horizontal arms, small joints, a round brass shade, and polished spherical details. The desk also holds a clear vase filled with pale white flowers, several stacked books, small glass objects, a round clock, and a few metallic decorative pieces.  Behind the desk is a tall armless chair upholstered in olive-green velvet. It has a straight rectangular back, a deep seat, and slim dark legs.  Two matching visitor chairs stand in front of the desk on the left. They have curved light brown wooden frames, open armrests, woven beige backs, pale cream seat cushions, and thin tapered legs. The chairs are placed side by side and face the desk.  A large traditional geometric rug covers most of the dark wooden floor. The rug contains dense borders, stripes, diamonds, and angular patterns in faded burgundy, dark red, brown, cream, black, muted blue, and pale green.  Natural light enters strongly from the left and creates bright highlights on the wooden doors, desk, brass objects, and glossy navy paneling. The shelves produce soft warm light in the darker center and right side of the room.

presets.title: Blue Pantry Passage
presets.summary: A centered doorway layers a blue pantry with a colorful dining room beyond.
presets.prompt: A centered vertical view from a small blue pantry through a large rectangular doorway into a colorful dining room. The composition follows a straight central perspective, with the doorway, chandelier, dining table, and window aligned through the middle.  The foreground room has a dark dusty-blue ceiling and built-in cabinetry on both sides. The large doorway is surrounded by a thick layered frame painted medium blue with a slightly glossy surface.  The wall around the doorway is covered with white wallpaper filled with loose abstract brush marks. The marks appear in bright red, coral, pale pink, mustard yellow, ochre, black, gray, lavender, brown, and muted blue. The irregular strokes are scattered closely across the entire wall.  Blue cabinets stand on both sides of the doorway. They have silver horizontal handles and pale white marble countertops with fine gray veins. The edges of glass-front upper cabinets are visible along both sides of the image.  On the left countertop is a clear glass cake dome containing several small pastries or pieces of bread. It stands on a dark metal base. A small decorative branch-shaped object lies beside it. Below the counter is a narrow glass-front refrigerator or cabinet with a silver handle.  Two small amber-colored glass containers sit on the right countertop. A colorful patterned towel hangs from the lower cabinet near the right edge.  Beyond the doorway is a bright dining room with a pale aqua coffered ceiling. Thick ceiling beams cross each other and form large recessed rectangular panels. The raised trim and inner sections are painted in slightly different shades of pale blue-green.  The dining room walls are vivid turquoise. The back wall is decorated with a detailed painted scene of thin flowering branches, pink and coral flowers, small birds, leaves, decorative vessels, and narrow ornamental tables against the turquoise background.  A tall multi-pane window is centered on the back wall. A natural woven wooden shade covers the upper part of the window. Long bright turquoise curtains hang on both sides and extend from near the ceiling to the floor. Soft daylight enters through the lower window panes.  A gold-colored hanging light is centered above the dining table. It hangs from a brass chain and has a tall open cage shape made from many thin vertical metal rods.  A long dark dining table extends from the center foreground toward the window. It has a softly rounded or oval end and a smooth dark brown surface. The table is surrounded by several light-colored dining chairs.  The closest chair has a white frame, slim legs, and a pale blue upholstered back covered with a repeating pattern of small red floral shapes. The chairs along the sides have pale frames, dark taupe or brown upholstered seats and backs, narrow wooden legs, and small brass-colored tips.  The table is arranged with clear drinking glasses, plates, bowls, folded napkins, and tall candlesticks. A large rounded bouquet of deep purple flowers stands in the center. Two tall red candles rise beside the flowers. A green bowl filled with yellow and orange fruit is placed closer to the foreground.  A large pale cream rug covers the dining room floor. The cool aqua ceiling, turquoise walls and curtains, blue doorway, warm gold chandelier, red details, and multicolored wallpaper create strong blocks of color throughout the view.

presets.title: Blush Tropical Living
presets.summary: Rattan, foliage, and coral trim create a bright collected interior.
presets.prompt: A wide view of a bright living room filled with tropical leaf patterns, warm pink architectural details, rattan furniture, a mustard-colored sofa, and many indoor plants.  The ceiling is painted soft blush pink. Several layered decorative borders run around its edges in white, coral red, and pale cream. The borders contain narrow stripes, small repeating triangular shapes, and fine raised details. A short black ceiling track with small spotlights is visible near the center.  A square white fluted column stands near the middle of the room. Its upper edge is decorated with small coral and green square details. The column separates the seating area from an open shelving section behind it.  The large wall on the left is covered with a tropical mural. The mural shows oversized banana leaves and other broad green foliage against a pale blush and cream background. White birds appear between the leaves, together with small pink flowers and pale branches.  A white fireplace is built into this mural wall. It has a simple rectangular mantel and a dark black firebox with horizontal warm brass elements inside. The mantel is decorated with a leafy plant, a purple crystal cluster, candles, books, and small ceramic objects.  Tall living plants with broad dark green leaves fill the far-left corner and overlap the mural. A floor lamp with a narrow pale base and a wide cream fabric shade stands beside the fireplace.  Two large lounge chairs are arranged along the left side of the room. They have curved honey-brown rattan frames, rounded arms, and woven bases. The chairs are upholstered with pale pink seat panels and green fabric printed with large tropical leaves. A small plain gray cushion rests on the chair near the fireplace. Another matching chair is partially cropped in the lower-left foreground.  Small round side tables stand beside the chairs. One has a warm brass-colored top and holds a decorated ceramic lamp or vase with dark geometric figures.  A large sofa occupies the right side of the seating area. It is upholstered in warm mustard-yellow velvet. The sofa has a deep button-tufted back, softly curved arms, three broad seat cushions, and short rounded wooden feet.  Several pillows are arranged across the sofa. They include pale cream pillows with fringed borders, smaller dark green pillows printed with tropical leaves, and a muted gold cushion.  Behind the sofa is a narrow console table with two matching lamps. Each lamp has a pale sculptural ceramic base covered with rounded raised details and a large cylindrical cream shade.  A tall open shelving unit covers part of the rear wall. It is divided into many white square compartments and contains books, small sculptures, ceramics, bowls, and colorful decorative objects. Soft warm light illuminates some of the shelves.  Large windows fill the right side of the room. Long sheer white curtains hang beside the glass and allow bright daylight to enter. A glowing brass starburst pendant with many pointed rays hangs near the upper-right corner.  A sculptural coffee table stands in the center. Its low base is made from many narrow curved rattan strips bent into smooth arches and rounded openings. A large shallow white bowl sits on top, filled with white orchid flowers, broad green leaves, and long stems.  The seating area stands on a large natural brown woven rug. The surrounding floor is made from small square terracotta tiles in different shades of brown.  A large decorative elephant sculpture stands beside the right end of the sofa. The elephant is pale cream and painted with detailed red, blue, turquoise, black, and gold decorations, including a patterned blanket and ornamental harness. A small turquoise side table is visible behind it.  The room is illuminated by bright daylight from the right windows, warm table lamps, and the glowing starburst light. The main colors are blush pink, tropical green, mustard yellow, pale cream, warm rattan brown, terracotta, coral red, and brass.

presets.title: Gray Sash Salon
presets.summary: Tall timber windows and ornate plaster bring calm proportion to a narrow room.
presets.prompt: Front-facing wide view of a long, narrow living room with a high white ceiling, ornate plaster crown molding, and a decorative round ceiling medallion. Pale cool gray walls with darker gray trim near the ceiling. Two tall wooden sash windows with warm brown frames stand on the back wall. Long light gray patterned curtains hang on both sides of the windows. A tall ornate pale gray mirror is centered between the windows.  A large brass ceiling chandelier hangs in the center of the room. It has a round central body and many long thin curved arms spreading outward, each arm ending with a small white bulb.  An off-white fabric sofa is placed under the left window. The sofa has several mixed cushions: gray textured cushions, cream cushions, a round white boucle cushion, and striped cushions in cream, rust, and muted red. A soft striped throw lies across the sofa. In front of it are two low round coffee tables made from pale beige stone, each with thin dark metal and brass legs. Books, a small bowl, a candle, and small decorative objects are placed on the tables.  The seating area stands on a large faded blue patterned rug. On the right side is a brown leather lounge chair with a dark wooden frame and wide wooden arms. A black and cream fringed blanket is draped over its back. A small black round side table beside the chair holds a glass with an amber drink. A light upholstered wooden armchair stands near the right window, with a cushion in red, blue, and white.  A gray painted fireplace is built into the right wall. Several framed pictures lean against the wall on the mantel. A dark wooden sideboard stands beside the fireplace, topped with a black sculptural vase filled with pale dried flowers. On the left side, a large dark wooden paneled door is open. Gray, cream, and mustard floor cushions are stacked near the doorway. Warm wooden floorboards are visible around the rug. Soft daylight enters through both windows. The camera is positioned at eye level, looking straight into the room.

presets.title: Charcoal Gable Living
presets.summary: A steep ceiling, pale fireplace, and bold artwork shape a dramatic lounge.
presets.prompt: Centered wide view of a dramatic living room with a high sloped ceiling and dark charcoal gray walls. A white fireplace is placed in the middle of the back wall. The fireplace has a simple stepped rectangular surround. Above it hangs a large vertical abstract painting with a mustard yellow background, a large rough green shape, and a smaller pale lavender brushstroke.  Built-in shelves are arranged symmetrically on both sides of the fireplace. The back panels of the shelves have a bold marbled pattern in dark blue, white, mustard yellow, and gold. Soft lights are built into the upper parts of the shelves. Decorative stone architectural fragments with carved scroll shapes sit at the top. The shelves contain metal bowls, glass jars, books, small lamps, framed art, and decorative objects.  The ceiling and upper walls are dark gray, while the lower walls have pale gray paneling. Tall windows are placed on both sides of the room. The windows have woven blinds, deep blue fabric Roman shades, and long blue curtains. The curtain borders have a white geometric Greek key pattern.  A long cognac brown tufted leather sofa stands along the right wall. It has large blue and white striped cushions and a soft gray blanket over one arm. Two large dark navy velvet armchairs are placed on the left side. A small antique-style armchair with bright green upholstery and a carved gold-toned wooden frame sits in front of the fireplace.  A rectangular glass coffee table with a thin dark metal frame stands in the center. Books, flowers, bowls, and small decorative objects are arranged on the glass surface. A large floor rug covers most of the room. It has repeating hexagonal and circular geometric shapes in gray, white, mustard yellow, and dark outlines.  A black metal chandelier hangs from the ceiling. It has several curved arms with small candle-shaped bulbs. Natural daylight enters from the windows on both sides, while small shelf lights create warm accents. The camera is centered at eye level, showing the room in a balanced, nearly symmetrical composition.

presets.title: Teal Formal Dining
presets.summary: Classical molding and deep teal surround a composed formal table.
presets.prompt: Wide front-facing view of a formal dining room with dark muted teal walls and a matching teal ceiling. The walls are covered with classical decorative molding, rectangular wall panels, carved corner ornaments, and elaborate plaster details. A large ornate plaster cornice runs around the ceiling. The center of the ceiling has a richly decorated round plaster medallion with floral and scroll patterns.  Three tall black-framed windows and glass doors fill the back wall. Green trees and a pale stone building are visible outside. Long sheer white curtains hang loosely beside the windows, with one curtain moving inward near the center door.  A large oval white marble dining table stands in the middle of the room. The marble has soft gray veins. The table is supported by two thick sculptural white marble pedestal bases. Around the table are several polished brass dining chairs with curved open metal backs, thin brass legs, and black upholstered seat cushions.  Three pendant lights hang above the table at different positions. Each light has a polished brass half-sphere top and a rounded clear ribbed glass lower section. Thin brass cords extend from the ceiling.  A large classical white marble statue of a standing nude male figure is placed near the right windows. On the left wall is a tall arched mirror with a wide ornate gold frame and carved decorative details at the top. Slim vertical wall lights with brass fittings and long white glass tubes are mounted beside the mirror.  Below the mirror stands a dark brown wooden sideboard with a smooth rectangular top and a heavy sculptural base shaped like natural roots or folded wood. Small black and white decorative objects, candles, and books are placed on top. A small brown sculptural head stands on the dining table with a few simple brass and black objects.  A large oval black and white striped rug lies under the table and chairs. The surrounding floor is made from warm brown wood arranged in a herringbone pattern. Daylight from the windows creates a soft contrast against the dark teal room. The camera is positioned at eye level, slightly angled toward the back-right side of the dining room.

presets.title: Ivory Gold Living
presets.summary: Cream upholstery, marble, and polished gold create a luminous formal room.
presets.prompt: Centered wide view of a spacious living room in warm white, cream, pale beige, marble, and polished gold. The room has a high white ceiling with ornate plaster crown molding, a recessed central ceiling area, and soft hidden lighting around the edges. The walls have classical rectangular panels, delicate floral plaster ornaments, and carved decorative details.  Three tall white-framed glass doors and windows fill the back wall. Long sheer white curtains cover the windows and allow bright soft daylight into the room. A large low white sofa stands across the back of the seating area. It has wide cushions and several large white pillows. In front of the sofa, on the left, is a large white upholstered chaise lounge with a low back and gold feet. A pale gray fur throw is draped across the chaise.  Two low rectangular marble coffee tables stand in the center and foreground. The tables are made from white stone with strong gray veining. Their thick block-shaped forms sit directly above the rug. Dark stone trays, gold bowls, books, and small decorative pieces are arranged on top.  A large beige rug covers the seating area. It has oversized abstract geometric and symbol-like shapes in taupe and brown. Warm wooden flooring in a herringbone pattern surrounds the rug.  A large sculptural chandelier hangs from the ceiling. It has a dark round center, many irregular folded gold metal pieces, and long clear illuminated glass rods extending outward in different directions. A tall polished gold floor lamp stands near the back-right side of the sofa, with several branching arms shaped like small horns.  Two tall white classical statues stand near the back windows and the right wall. On the far left is a tall gold room divider made from many narrow vertical metal rods. In front of it stands a clear acrylic side table holding dark brown glass bottles, black decorative objects, books, and a small black horse sculpture.  An irregular round mirror with a wide layered gold frame hangs on the left wall. On the right side is a white decorative fireplace with carved plaster details. A large antique-style mirror with a dark gold carved frame hangs above the fireplace. White and dark decorative objects are arranged on the mantel. Small geometric gold wall lights are mounted on the walls. The camera is positioned low at seated eye level and looks straight across the room.

presets.title: Gilded Console
presets.summary: A centered decorative vignette pairs pale paneling with sculptural gold.
presets.prompt: Portrait composition, straight front view of a decorative console against a tall pale warm gray wall. The camera is centered and placed at eye level. The composition is almost symmetrical.  The wall has thin classical rectangular molding. Small carved plaster details decorate the lower corners of the wall panels. The floor is made from light natural wood arranged in a herringbone pattern.  A wide sculptural console stands in the center. The console is made from glossy black marble with thin white veins and strong orange-gold veins. Its body has an angular geometric shape with sloping sides and several large faceted planes across the front. There are no visible handles. A narrow recessed base under the console is made from pale warm wood with a subtle geometric line pattern.  Above the console hangs a large irregular round mirror. The outer edge is uneven and organic. Polished gold metal branches cross over the mirror and divide it into many different shapes, like an open web made from melted metal. Some parts of the mirror are open and clean, while other parts are crossed by thick gold lines. The mirror reflects a dark wall with open shelves, small decorative objects, and a branching ceiling light with clear glass spheres.  Two small matching gold wall decorations are mounted to the left and right of the mirror. Each one has a narrow vertical organic form with pointed ends and an uneven polished surface.  On the left side of the console is a small table lamp. It has a tilted polished brass dome shade and a short white marble stem with gray veins. On the right side is a small polished gold sculpture of a reclining human figure lying on its side.  Open passages are partly visible on both sides of the central wall. A few green plant leaves appear at the far right edge. Soft daylight fills the room, with gentle warm light reflected from the gold surfaces.

presets.title: Columned White Living
presets.summary: Fluted columns and carved plaster organize a spacious white interior.
presets.prompt: Wide front-facing view of a large white living room connected to a dining room in the background. The camera is centered at eye level. The room has a high white ceiling with detailed plaster borders, floral ornaments, and carved classical molding.  Two tall white fluted columns stand near the center of the room. Each column has a richly carved capital at the top. The columns divide the living area in the foreground from the dining area behind them. The walls are white and decorated with thin rectangular panels and small plaster ornaments. The floor is pale warm wood.  The living area contains a large curved sofa on the left. The sofa has a low rounded back, a soft light gray-beige fabric, and an asymmetrical crescent shape. Several rectangular cushions in similar pale gray tones rest along the back. Small polished gold details appear on the ends of the sofa.  Two rounded armchairs are placed on the right side. One chair stands near the center and faces the camera. The second chair is closer to the front-right corner and is turned toward the sofa. Both chairs have thick curved backs, rounded sides, pale gray fabric, and small round gold details on their outer arms.  A group of small coffee tables stands in the center. The tables have different sizes and heights. Their bases are irregular polished gold cylinders with uneven surfaces. The tops are pale white stone with rough organic edges. A clear curved glass sculpture and a few small dark objects are placed on the tables.  A very large pale rug covers the living area. It has an irregular flower-like outline and an abstract pattern in cream, beige, light gray, and soft gold.  In the background is a long dining table surrounded by thin polished gold chairs with pale seats. Two large gold pendant lights hang above the table. Each pendant is formed from a glowing round cluster of small clear and gold pieces. A large wall sculpture made from several open polished gold loops hangs behind the dining table.  Two large tropical plants with wide green leaves stand on both sides of the dining area. Each plant is placed in a black sculptural pedestal pot.  On the left wall is a tall white display cabinet with curved decorative edges and dark glass doors. On the right wall is a large round convex mirror with a reflective silver surface and gold details in the center. Below it stands a narrow console supported by many clustered white spheres with several gold spheres mixed between them. Tall arched windows and doors on the right bring soft daylight into the room.

presets.title: Glass Wall Retreat
presets.summary: A full-height facade reveals a warm modern room from the outdoor deck.
