presets.prompt: Very wide straight-on view from an outdoor wooden deck through a full-height glass wall into a modern open-plan living and dining room. The camera is outside the building and faces the interior directly.  Dark brown narrow wooden deck boards fill the bottom foreground. A large glass facade stretches across the entire image. The glass wall is divided into many tall sliding panels with slim silver metal frames. A wide white horizontal architectural beam runs above the glass. The glass is clean and transparent, with only light reflections.  Inside, the ceiling is low and flat with large pale gray panels. Small round recessed lights and a few square black ceiling lights are evenly placed across it. The interior floor is made from large pale gray stone slabs.  The dining area is on the left. A long black rectangular dining table has a thick flat top and a large round brushed-metal pedestal base. Several dining chairs surround it. The chairs have slim dark wooden frames, straight arms, and tan leather seats and backs. A long dark wood cabinet runs along the left wall.  Behind the dining area is a tall wall covered in warm light wood panels. A delicate wall sculpture made from thin dark branches and many flat white leaf shapes spreads across the wood surface. A white round structural column stands near this wall.  The living area is on the right. A large low white modular sofa is arranged along the back wall and continues toward the right side. The sofa has broad square seats, low backs, and many white cushions. A pale rectangular rug lies under the seating area.  Several low coffee tables stand in front of the sofa. They have dark rounded tops and pale cylindrical bases. Small bowls and decorative objects rest on the tables. Two solid rectangular wooden stools are placed in the foreground facing the sofa.  Two very tall narrow floor lights stand near the glass facade. Each light has a slim silver vertical tube, a small black base, and a dark band near the middle.  The main back wall is white. A large horizontal artwork hangs in the center. It contains two detailed circular patterns made from many small shapes in red, orange, yellow, purple, white, and dark blue. A long low pale cabinet runs below the artwork.  Glass partitions, gray stone walls, white columns, and another white lounge seat appear on the right side. Strong daylight enters from above and from the right, creating long diagonal shadows across the white wall and floor.

presets.title: Organic Gold Mirror
presets.summary: Branching polished metal transforms a classical console and mirror composition.
presets.prompt: Wide front-facing view of a white classical interior, centered on a decorative console and a large mirror. The camera is placed at eye level. A central wall section projects forward and separates two open passages on the left and right.  The walls are warm white with thin rectangular panel molding and delicate carved plaster ornaments. Detailed white crown molding runs around the ceiling. The floor is made from pale natural wood arranged in a herringbone pattern.  A long reflective console stands against the central wall. It has a straight polished gold top and a large mirror-like gold front panel. The surface reflects the floor, dining chairs, and objects in the room. Two large rough gold branches grow upward across the front of the console. One branch rises from the left side and the second rises from the right, with long curved arms stretching across the reflective panel. The console stands on a narrow pale wooden base.  Above the console hangs a large irregular round mirror. The mirror has an uneven organic outline. Thick polished gold branches cross over the glass and divide it into many open shapes, forming a loose web. The mirror reflects a dark wall with shelves, a branching ceiling light with clear glass spheres, and gold dining furniture.  Two small matching gold wall decorations are mounted on both sides of the mirror. They have narrow pointed organic shapes and polished uneven surfaces.  On the left side of the console is a dark bronze abstract sculpture on a small black rectangular base. The sculpture has a narrow upright body and very long horizontal branching arms extending to both sides. On the right side are a slim dark glass vase, a white cylindrical candle jar, a short stack of large books, and two dark decorative candlesticks with tall thin white candles.  Through the opening on the left, a tall white classical female statue stands beside long sheer white curtains. Bright daylight enters through the window behind the curtains. A small sculptural gold side table is partly visible near the statue.  The right opening leads into a white corridor with paneled doors and detailed plaster wall decoration. A small gold wall ornament is mounted in the corridor, and one large green leaf appears near a doorway. Soft daylight comes from the left, while warm hidden ceiling light creates a gentle glow along the upper walls.

presets.title: Ornate Cabinet
presets.summary: A freestanding decorative cabinet becomes a precise vertical object study.
presets.prompt: Vertical front-facing view of a decorative freestanding cabinet placed against a warm white wall. The camera is centered at eye level, with the cabinet as the main object.  The room has warm white walls covered with classical rectangular molding. The wall panels have delicate raised plaster ornaments in the upper corners and larger floral scroll details near the lower edges. The molding and ornaments are painted the same warm white color as the wall.  The cabinet has two clearly different sections. The upper section is a wide closed box with a gently curved top edge and slightly angled upper corners. Its entire front surface is covered with a geometric pattern made from many small triangles. Thin dark lines separate every triangle. The pattern combines deep navy blue, teal blue, black, white, cream, pale beige, tan, brown, coral pink, soft red, lavender, muted green, and small yellow accents. The darker blue triangles form larger shapes across the lower and central areas, while lighter cream and white triangles are concentrated around the edges.  The lower section is an open polished gold metal stand. It has a tall rectangular outer frame, narrow vertical supports, and a large circular ring placed inside the frame. A curved gold band crosses through the circle. The polished metal reflects the pale floor and surrounding wall.  On both sides of the cabinet are tall white planters containing green ferns with long narrow leaves. Each planter is supported by a slim open metal stand with a round gold base and narrow decorative legs. The planter on the right is partly cut off by the edge of the image.  A small vertical abstract wall decoration hangs to the left of the cabinet. It is made from several irregular folded pieces in muted gold, pale gray, warm beige, and soft green.  The floor is polished white marble with faint gray veining. Thin gold inlay lines form a large rectangular border around the furniture. Soft warm light enters from the upper right side, creating long gentle shadows from the cabinet and plants.

presets.title: Cream Formal Salon
presets.summary: Pale classical architecture and balanced seating produce quiet elegance.
presets.prompt: Wide centered view of a formal living room in pale cream, soft beige, white, gray, and polished gold. The camera is positioned at eye level and looks straight toward the back wall.  The room has a very high white ceiling with detailed classical plaster molding. A large rectangular ceiling border is decorated with floral scrollwork in the corners. A round ornate ceiling medallion is centered above the seating area.  A large sculptural chandelier hangs from the center of the ceiling. It is formed from many glowing white glass spheres attached to a complex polished gold structure. Irregular gold plates, curved branches, and small reflective pieces are mixed between the round lights, creating a dense floating cluster.  A large pale beige sectional sofa fills the middle of the room. The sofa has a low profile, broad cushions, square arms, and many large soft pillows in matching cream and pale blush tones. The left section extends toward the camera as a chaise lounge. The back section runs across the center. The right section ends in a large polished gold outer panel with an uneven reflective surface.  In front of the sofa is a low sculptural coffee table. Its base is made from many connected polished gold spheres and rounded organic forms, with several small black spheres mixed into the design. A wide transparent glass top rests above the base. Books, small dark decorative objects, and a few gold pieces are arranged on the tabletop.  The seating area stands on a large gray rug with flowing abstract patterns in charcoal, white, and pale gray. Dark warm wood flooring arranged in a herringbone pattern is visible around the rug.  A very tall ornate mirror stands against the center of the back wall. It has a dark carved wooden frame with a decorative curved crown. The mirror reflects the chandelier, pale double doors, and part of the sofa. The back wall and side walls are covered with white rectangular panel molding.  Tall windows line the right side of the room. Long light beige curtains hang from thin black rods. Bright daylight enters through the windows and creates soft reflections on the gold surfaces. A pale classical bust is visible near the back-right corner. Part of a black fireplace appears along the far left edge.

presets.title: Black Garden Dining
presets.summary: A sculptural white chandelier floats between dark walls and a green view.
presets.prompt: Wide front-facing view of a dining room with deep black textured walls, a white ceiling, warm wooden flooring, and a centered window opening toward a green garden. The camera is placed at eye level and looks straight toward the dining table.  A large white sculptural chandelier hangs above the center of the room. It is made from many long narrow white glass rods arranged in a rounded layered form. The rods point upward at different heights, while many thin curved white arms loop downward below them, creating a soft cage-like shape. The chandelier hangs from a thin metal chain.  A large oval dining table stands directly below the chandelier. The tabletop is white marble with soft gray veining and a rounded edge. It is supported by slim polished brass legs.  Several dining chairs surround the table. The chairs have curved open frames in warm wood or bronze-toned metal and white upholstered seats and backs. Two chairs are positioned on the left, two on the right, and one chair faces the camera in the foreground. The front chair is covered with long soft white fur across its back and seat, with narrow gold-colored legs visible below.  A tall striped ceramic vase stands in the center of the table. It contains long green stems with small round dark flowers. Beside it is a low white bowl filled with green moss.  The back wall has a large central window or glass door. Green trees, a pale house, and a small lawn are visible outside. Tall curtains frame the opening. The fabric has bold vertical black and cream stripes with rough textured edges and small fringed details. A slim polished gold curtain rod runs above the window.  The right wall displays a large four-panel artwork arranged in a two-by-two grid. The image shows a close view of a pale horse with a long flowing mane, printed in soft black, white, gray, and muted brown tones.  On the left wall hangs a tall geometric mirror made from several angled mirrored sections. Below it stands a low sideboard made from glossy burl wood with rounded corners and a narrow polished gold base. Two matching table lamps sit on the sideboard. Each lamp has a rounded white ceramic base, small brass details, and a wide beige fabric shade.  A large cream rug lies under the dining table and chairs. It has a simple pattern of thin irregular dark lines. Natural daylight from the window creates a bright center surrounded by the dark walls.

presets.title: Taupe Home Library
presets.summary: Built-in bookshelves, a writing desk, and soft daylight create a lived-in study.
presets.prompt: Wide front-facing view of a traditional home office and library. The camera is placed at seated eye level and looks directly toward a central window surrounded by built-in shelving.  The room is lined with tall built-in bookcases painted in a muted warm gray and taupe color. The shelves cover the back wall and continue along both side walls. Lower cabinets have paneled doors with small dark round handles. Open shelves above contain rows of brown, tan, green, and dark blue books, framed drawings, blue and white porcelain vases, decorative plates, small bird sculptures, green plants, bowls, and other small objects.  Small black picture lights are mounted above the upper sections of the shelves. The upper trim of the cabinets continues around the room as a simple crown molding.  A tall multi-pane window is centered on the back wall. Long off-white curtains hang on both sides. A woven Roman shade in muted brown, beige, and gray covers the upper part of the window. Soft daylight enters through the lower glass panes.  A narrow dark carved wooden console table stands below the window. It has turned legs and detailed carving along the front edge. A traditional table lamp with a narrow decorative base and a beige shade stands on the left side. Small ceramic and metal objects are arranged across the top.  A large rectangular writing desk stands on the right side of the room. It is made from dark reddish-brown wood and has a flat top with inset panels, slim straight legs, and small brass details near the feet. A large brown ceramic vase filled with broad green and rust-colored leaves sits on the back corner. A closed book or notebook and a small cup rest on the desktop. A gray ergonomic office chair with a curved mesh back and black wheeled base is placed behind the desk.  On the left side is a quiet seating area. A pale gray upholstered sofa is partly visible in the foreground. A matching armchair with rounded arms stands near the shelves. A rectangular upholstered ottoman is placed in front of the chair, with a soft gray throw draped across it. Pale patterned cushions rest on the sofa and chair. A small dark side table stands between them.  A light gray carpet covers most of the floor. It has a subtle repeating curved pattern. The room is evenly lit with soft daylight and warm accent light from the lamps.

presets.title: Low White Pavilion
presets.summary: A long minimalist house settles quietly into a planted garden.
presets.prompt: Vertical front-left exterior view of a single-story minimalist house. The house is a long, low rectangular volume that continues diagonally from the left foreground toward the right background. It has a flat roof with a thin dark charcoal edge and a deep continuous roof overhang. The exterior walls are covered with smooth warm gray-beige stucco.  On the left side of the facade are three tall narrow windows with thin black metal frames. The upper parts of the windows are clear glass, while the lower parts are frosted. Near the center is a black double front door made from several rectangular frosted glass panels. A slim vertical window stands beside the door. Small warm recessed lights are evenly spaced under the roof overhang.  A shallow light concrete porch with broad steps runs along the entrance. The front garden is covered with fine dark gray gravel. Large pale rectangular concrete slabs form a geometric path from the foreground to the front door. A long rectangular concrete planter below the windows contains tall pale ornamental grasses with soft feathery tops.  In the foreground is a curved dry garden bed edged with rounded river stones in gray, beige, and soft brown colors. It contains a round green shrub, a large spiky green yucca, and a small pale green succulent. On the right is a low black rectangular water basin with a dark stacked-stone waterfall wall. Sparse desert plants surround the water feature. Pale evening sky, soft natural light, warm exterior lights, clean and open composition.

presets.title: Blue-Hour Urban Stack
presets.summary: Dark stacked volumes and warm timber soffits glow at dusk.
presets.prompt: Vertical centered front view of a narrow three-story contemporary urban house during blue hour. The facade is made from dark charcoal and black metal panels arranged as several stacked rectangular volumes. A tall solid vertical column runs from the ground to the roof near the center-left of the building.  Several roof sections project forward at different heights. Their lower surfaces are sharply angled and covered with warm natural wood. Small recessed lights are built into the wooden roof surfaces. Large floor-to-ceiling windows with thin black frames cover most of the front facade. Warm interior lighting is visible through the glass.  The upper level has large triangular and rectangular window sections beneath the sloping roof surfaces. Clear glass balcony railings are placed on the upper left and upper center. The middle level has large windows on both sides, a dark horizontal balcony wall, and another wooden ceiling beneath the upper floor.  At ground level, a black framed double entrance door stands near the center with a glass panel above it. Warm wall lights are mounted beside the entrance. A large glass room is visible on the left. Wide windows on the right sit behind a low dark gray privacy wall.  Broad white concrete steps rise from the foreground toward the entrance. Large rectangular concrete slabs continue along the path, separated by thin dark joints. The front garden contains curved green lawn areas, dark soil beds, groups of tall ornamental grasses, round green plants, low gray-green shrubs, raised rectangular planters, and small warm landscape lights. Mature trees frame both sides and the upper corners. Clear deep blue evening sky and warm light glowing from inside the house.

presets.title: Modern Twin Gables
presets.summary: Traditional roof forms meet crisp glazing and restrained pale masonry.
presets.prompt: Wide straight-on front view of a tall three-level house combining traditional gabled shapes with modern details. The main facade is covered with light cream and white painted brick. Two large steep front-facing gables stand on the left and right sides. Both gables have dark trim, small rectangular roof vents, and dark gray shingle roofing. Several dark solar panels are installed on the center section of the roof.  The windows have dark brown or black frames with simple rectangular grid patterns. The upper left and upper right sections each have a large square window. A small narrow window is placed between the two gables.  On the right side is a large projecting rectangular section covered with smooth gray panels. It contains a wide multi-pane window and is topped by a shallow dark metal roof. Below it is a single dark garage door with several horizontal frosted glass strips. A second shallow dark metal roof runs above the garage.  On the left side is an open balcony with dark metal railings. A straight exterior staircase with wooden steps and dark railings rises from the garden to the balcony. The balcony entrance is surrounded by warm horizontal wood slats and covered by a dark metal roof. Directly below it is another dark entrance door, also framed by warm wood slats.  The front yard has a smooth green lawn, low rounded shrubs, small flowering plants, and a few ornamental grasses. A pale concrete driveway leads from the street to the garage. A short path made from square concrete slabs leads to the lower entrance. A narrow curved garden path continues along the right side of the house. Large mature trees fill the background. Soft gray overcast daylight and a centered street-level composition showing the complete facade.

presets.title: Mid-Century Charcoal
presets.summary: Overlapping low roofs and dark horizontal lines frame a warm modern home.
presets.prompt: Square front-left exterior view of a single-story mid-century modern house. The house has a long low shape with several overlapping single-slope roof sections at different heights. The roof edges and main exterior walls are dark charcoal. Wide roof overhangs create strong horizontal lines across the facade.  Warm horizontal wood siding covers the garage area on the left and parts of the central entrance section. The garage has a wide sectional door made from large frosted glass panels divided by thick black horizontal frames. A tall dark chimney rises behind the left side of the house.  The main entrance is near the center. It has a tall dark wood front door, a narrow vertical glass panel beside it, and a small raised concrete porch. A glass corner section with black frames stands between the entrance and the right wing. The center of the house has a raised roof section with warm wood siding and a narrow upper window.  The right wing is covered with dark horizontal siding. Two large rectangular windows with black frames show warm interior light. Warm recessed lights are evenly spaced beneath the roof overhangs around the garage, entrance, and right wing.  A broad light gray concrete driveway fills most of the foreground and curves toward the garage. A narrow black soil bed follows the edge of the driveway. Small round green shrubs are planted in a repeated line through this bed. A second row of smaller round plants leads toward the front entrance. The right side has a smooth bright green lawn, low ornamental grasses, a small decorative tree near the entrance, and a larger gray-green shrub below the windows. Tall mature trees surround the property. Dark heavy storm clouds fill the sky, with a narrow area of warm sunset light visible on the left. Warm house lighting contrasts with the cool dark sky.

presets.title: Seafoam Craftsman
presets.summary: Painted shingles and bright porch details refresh a classic bungalow.
presets.prompt: Vertical front-left exterior view of a traditional two-level Craftsman bungalow. The house is covered with small seafoam green painted shingles. All roof edges, window frames, beams, brackets, and porch details are painted white.  A large front-facing gable dominates the facade. It has wide white trim, decorative white support brackets, and a group of three white-framed windows near the top. Behind it is a second steep roof covered with weathered reddish-brown tiles. Two narrow brick chimneys rise above the roof.  The ground floor has a deep covered front porch. Two large tapered white columns stand on square green shingle-covered bases. A warm natural wood front door is placed on the right side of the porch. The door has several narrow glass panels and a glass section above it. A large hanging lantern is suspended near the entrance, and a smaller wall lantern is mounted between the door and the front window.  A wide multi-pane white-framed window fills the left side of the porch. A white projecting window ledge with decorative brackets runs below it. Two muted green cushions are visible in the window seating area. Warm table lamps and furniture can be seen inside the room.  The front garden is divided by low, carefully trimmed boxwood hedges. Inside the hedges are small flower beds with yellow, orange, red, and purple flowers. A narrow pale stone walkway runs along the right side of the garden and rises by two shallow wooden-edged steps toward the porch. Irregular rectangular stone slabs form another path in the foreground. A wooden picnic table stands on the lawn in the lower-left corner. A large mature tree stretches across the top of the frame, with thick dark branches and dense green leaves creating a natural canopy. Soft daylight, green residential surroundings, and neighboring houses partly visible behind the garden.

presets.title: Slate Stone Residence
presets.summary: Natural stone, a deep roof, and dark openings give a grounded stately presence.
presets.prompt: Wide straight-on front view of a two-story house with a traditional stone exterior and modern dark details. The main body has a tall pyramidal hipped roof covered with small rectangular gray slate tiles in slightly varied shades. A stone chimney rises behind the left side of the roof and has a wide dark cap.  The upper floor is a simple dark charcoal rectangular section beneath the main roof. Two narrow vertical windows with thick black frames are placed evenly across this dark wall. A broad lower roof covered with matching gray slate extends across the left and center of the facade, creating a deep covered porch. Small recessed lights are visible beneath the porch roof.  Most of the ground floor is covered with irregular natural stone in muted gray, brown, rust, and beige tones. The main entrance is near the center. It has a pair of warm medium-brown wooden doors with tall divided glass panels and a gently curved top. A black rectangular wall lantern and a small dark address plaque are placed to the left of the entrance. A narrow black-framed window stands farther left.  The right side of the house has a prominent front-facing stone gable with thick black trim. Near the top of the gable is a small circular black-framed window divided by a cross. Below it is a projecting three-sided bay window with tall narrow black-framed glass panels. The bay window is covered by a small faceted gray slate roof with a dark edge.  A low stone wall creates a raised sitting terrace across the left side of the facade. A dark woven lounge chair with light cushions stands behind the wall. A rectangular planter with small pale flowers is placed near the entrance.  The front garden combines a small rectangular lawn with white gravel beds and carefully arranged plants. It contains round green shrubs, low purple flowering plants, upright ornamental grasses, small spiky plants, and groups of soft green ground cover. Large flat gray rectangular slabs form a geometric path from the foreground to the front steps and continue across the garden. Small circular ground lights are set into the gravel. Mature green trees stand behind the left side of the house, and part of a neighboring brick house is visible on the right. Bright soft daylight under a pale cloudy sky.

presets.title: Stone-Trim Infill
presets.summary: A narrow urban house balances warm stucco, stacked stone, and charcoal trim.
presets.prompt: Vertical straight-on view of a narrow two-story contemporary house positioned closely between two neighboring homes. The facade combines smooth warm off-white stucco, pale gray stacked stone, and strong dark charcoal trim. The roof consists of two asymmetrical sloping planes with deep black fascia and wide projecting eaves. The left roof plane rises toward the center, while the right roof plane slopes downward toward the side.  The upper left side has a large group of tall black-framed windows. The composition includes several narrow vertical glass panels, small horizontal panels along the bottom, and smaller rectangular sections along the left edge. A dark triangular wall area follows the slope of the roof above these windows.  The upper right side has one large square black-framed window with a narrow vertical column of two smaller windows beside it. The glass reflects the pale blue-gray sky. The walls surrounding the upper windows are covered with smooth light beige stucco.  The ground floor has a single wide garage on the left. The garage door is flat, dark charcoal, and divided by subtle horizontal lines. Pale stacked stone covers the wall around and above the garage. A thick dark horizontal canopy extends across the top of the garage and toward the entrance.  The main entrance is deeply recessed near the center. A tall black front door has a narrow vertical glass section, a small rectangular glass panel near the top, and a slim sidelight. A dark ceiling with one warm recessed light covers the entrance. A tall rectangular column covered with pale stacked stone stands to the right of the door and continues upward between the two main sections of the facade.  A large floor-to-ceiling black-framed window fills the lower right side. A young tree with a thin pale trunk and bright yellow-green leaves stands in front of this window.  The front garden has a curved geometric layout. Large pale rectangular stepping slabs form a winding path from the sidewalk toward the entrance. The slabs are separated by narrow bands of dark rounded stones. The surrounding planting beds are covered with black mulch and contain repeated groups of soft green ornamental grasses. A smooth rounded area of bright green lawn fills the lower-left corner. A pale paved driveway leads to the garage. Neighboring houses with light horizontal siding are visible very close on both sides. Soft overcast daylight and a clean centered composition.

presets.title: Split-Tone Minimal House
presets.summary: Two compact volumes divide a clean facade into light and charcoal halves.
presets.prompt: Vertical centered front view of a compact two-story minimalist house made from simple rectangular volumes. The facade is divided into two main colors. The left section is smooth warm off-white, while the right section is covered with dark charcoal gray stucco. Both sections have flat roofs with thin dark parapet edges.  The taller off-white volume projects slightly forward on the left. A very narrow vertical window with a thin black frame is deeply recessed into the upper wall. Near the center of the upper floor is a second tall narrow window placed inside a recessed opening. A thick rectangular off-white canopy projects above this opening. A low off-white parapet wall extends across its lower part, creating the appearance of a small protected balcony.  The dark charcoal upper section on the right has one large vertical window divided into two tall glass panels by a central black frame. The window is positioned slightly above the center of the dark wall.  The ground-floor entrance is recessed beneath a deep off-white rectangular overhang. Two small warm recessed lights are installed in the ceiling above the doorway. The front door is large, tall, and made from warm dark brown wood. Its entire surface is covered with a symmetrical carved floral and scrolling pattern. A tall narrow floor-to-ceiling glass sidelight with a black frame stands directly to the left of the door.  The lower right section has a large floor-to-ceiling black-framed window divided vertically into two panels. A softly lit interior with pale walls and dark furniture is visible through the glass. The dark upper wall continues around this window.  A straight pale concrete path begins at the bottom center of the image and leads directly to the front entrance. Thin horizontal joints divide the path into broad rectangular sections. Neatly cut green lawn covers both sides of the walkway. A rounded leafy shrub stands near the lower-left corner of the house. Small ornamental grasses and low shrubs are planted below the large right window. A young slender tree stands on the far right side of the lawn. Pale evening sky with soft blue and cream-colored clouds, gentle natural light, and subtle warm light from inside the house.

presets.title: Evening Black Pavilion
presets.summary: Flat dark volumes and lit glazing create a calm early-evening silhouette.
presets.prompt: Wide front view of a compact single-story modern house during early evening. The building is composed of overlapping rectangular volumes with different heights and completely flat roofs. The facade uses dark charcoal cladding, black metal framing, and several smooth white vertical panels.  A large dark rectangular frame surrounds the right half of the house. Its upper section projects forward and creates a deep shadow beneath it. A long horizontal black-framed window is placed directly below the upper dark volume. Warm white interior light is visible through the glass.  The main entrance is positioned slightly right of center inside a dark recessed section. The front door is flat and dark charcoal with a narrow vertical glass strip beside the handle. Two thin horizontal metal accents are placed near the upper and lower parts of the door. A small warm recessed light is installed in the dark ceiling above the entrance.  To the right of the door is a tall floor-to-ceiling black-framed window with a wide horizontal transom above it. A softly lit sitting area with pale walls and warm brown furniture is visible inside. The dark wall and roof form a thick frame around the window.  A tall smooth white rectangular wall panel separates the entrance area from the left side of the facade. Behind it are several stepped white volumes at different heights. The left side has another dark rectangular block and a large floor-to-ceiling glass opening with narrow black frames. A bright white interior with pale furniture is visible through this glass. A small black wall light on the far-left dark wall casts light upward and downward.  The entrance is raised above the garden by a series of broad geometric steps. The steps have white horizontal surfaces and dark charcoal vertical faces. They extend asymmetrically across the front, forming several long platforms. A dark gray deck made from narrow rectangular boards covers the left entrance terrace. Smooth dark river stones fill a narrow bed along the lower edge of the image.  The landscaping is minimal. A single small potted plant stands near the left glass opening. Low dark planting beds surround the steps. Dense trees frame the left and right edges, and a horizontal wooden fence is visible on the right. Pale gray-blue evening sky, warm interior lights, and a centered frontal composition.

presets.title: Limestone Country Estate
presets.summary: Steep slate roofs and pale stone compose a broad European residence.
presets.prompt: Wide front-left view of a large European country-style residence during blue hour. The house has a long asymmetrical facade covered with pale gray and off-white rectangular limestone blocks. The roof is very tall and steep, covered with small dark blue-gray slate tiles. Several front-facing gables, curved roof sections, and arched dormer windows create a complex roofline.  A tall rectangular stone chimney rises above the right side of the roof. It has a wide layered cap and dark trim along the top. Directly below the chimney is a steep front-facing gable outlined with thick black trim. A tall narrow black-framed window is placed in the center of the gable. A traditional wall lantern above the window produces a warm amber glow.  Below this right gable is a projecting rectangular bay window with black frames. It is covered by a small dark faceted roof. Warm interior light is visible through the divided glass panels.  The central and left sections have several smaller front gables with dark edges. Two arched dormer windows project from the sloping roof. Each dormer has a curved dark roof, pale stone framing, and a narrow arched window glowing with warm light.  The main entrance is left of center beneath a pointed front gable. It has a large pair of tall arched black-framed glass doors divided into many rectangular panes. Broad pale stone steps lead up to the entrance. Large round planters with carefully trimmed shrubs stand on both sides.  A second smaller arched black-framed door is placed near the center of the facade. Another tall arched opening is visible on the far left. Traditional black wall lanterns are mounted in pairs beside the doors and windows. Warm ground lights shine upward across the pale stone walls, creating vertical patterns of light and shadow.  The formal front garden contains long low boxwood hedges, rounded topiary shrubs, small upright trees in planters, dark planting beds, and narrow areas of neatly cut grass. A square stone pedestal with a decorative lantern stands near the right foreground.  A broad curved pale driveway occupies most of the foreground. Its slightly reflective surface shows soft amber reflections from the facade lights. The house extends from the far left toward the closer right side, creating a gentle diagonal perspective. Mature trees rise behind the roof and frame the edges of the property. Dark blue-gray cloudy evening sky and warm golden light glowing from all windows and exterior lanterns.

presets.title: Mustard Roof House
presets.summary: A sharp yellow roof edge turns a compact charcoal facade into a bold landmark.
presets.prompt: Vertical centered street-level view of a compact two-story house on a narrow residential lot. The entire building is covered with narrow vertical charcoal-black metal siding. The facade is made from two slightly offset rectangular volumes with an asymmetrical roofline.  The left upper volume has a nearly flat roof with a thin black edge. A wide horizontal window with three dark-framed glass panels is placed in the center of this wall. A small square black-framed window is positioned closer to the middle of the house. A simple television antenna rises above the roof.  The right volume has a single sloping roof that descends from the center toward the right side. The roof has a bright mustard-yellow fascia and a wide yellow underside. The yellow roof edge projects beyond the wall and creates a strong diagonal line across the upper facade.  The ground floor has a recessed entrance area. The left wall inside the recess is bright yellow and contains a wide black-framed window divided into three sections. A solid yellow front door stands near the center inside a narrow dark recess. A slim vertical black panel is placed beside the door. One small ceiling light is installed above the entrance.  The lower right section remains charcoal black and contains a wide rectangular black-framed window. Three shallow pale gray steps lead up to the front door.  The front garden is enclosed by a low black fence made from vertical metal panels. A narrow gate is centered directly in front of the entrance. Large light gray rectangular concrete slabs form a straight walkway from the sidewalk to the steps. Thin strips of small dark stones separate the slabs.  The garden beds are covered with fine black gravel. They contain several green agaves, low succulents, small upright grasses, and a few smooth white decorative stones. A pale gravel driveway runs along the right side of the house. A tall natural wood fence stands on the left. Low neighboring houses are visible on both sides.  Large mature trees surround the property and frame the upper part of the image. Bright blue sky with thin pale clouds, clear sunny daylight, and strong diagonal shadows across the black facade.

presets.title: Pine Ridge House
presets.summary: Stone foundations and dark upper volumes step through a dense forest site.
presets.prompt: Vertical elevated front view of a large multi-level house surrounded by a dense pine forest. The building combines rough natural stone on the lower level with dark charcoal vertical siding on the upper floors. The house has several connected volumes with low sloping roofs covered in dark standing-seam metal.  The lower level stretches across the front of the house and is covered with irregular gray, beige, and brown fieldstone. On the left is a large flat black garage door with a narrow row of small windows near the top. Near the center is a simple narrow black entrance door. A wide horizontal black-framed window is placed to the right of this door. Warm wall lanterns are mounted on the stone facade.  Above the garage is a projecting left wing with a large sloping metal roof that descends toward the viewer. The roof has deep black edges. Below it is a long wall of floor-to-ceiling black-framed glass, with warm interior rooms visible through the windows.  The taller central and right parts of the house are covered with black vertical siding. Large rectangular windows are arranged across several levels. The upper floor has a long row of tall windows beneath the low roof overhang. A short rectangular chimney rises near the left side of the main roof.  On the right is a covered elevated entrance and balcony with dark posts, a black roof, and warm recessed lights. A large glass door opens into a warmly lit interior. Black metal railings surround the landing.  A long exterior staircase descends diagonally from the elevated entrance toward the lower right foreground. The staircase has thick black steel supports, natural wood steps, and black metal mesh railings. A second railing continues along the upper platform.  A broad gray paved courtyard fills most of the foreground. Its surface is made from small rectangular gray pavers and curves gently around the building. Long bands of sunlight create sharp bright shapes across the paving.  The surrounding landscape contains dark brown mulch beds, natural rocks, low rounded shrubs, small flowering plants, and narrow areas of white gravel. Very tall straight pine trees rise behind and around the house. Warm interior lights contrast with the green forest and dark exterior. Late afternoon sunlight filters through the trees and creates long shadows.

presets.title: Charcoal Timber Porch
presets.summary: Warm timber posts soften a dark gabled house among autumn trees.
presets.prompt: Wide front-left exterior view of a dark charcoal one-and-a-half-story house with several steep gabled roofs. The walls are covered with vertical board-and-batten siding in a deep gray-black color. All window frames, roof edges, gutters, and decorative trim are also dark.  The roof is covered with dark gray standing-seam metal panels. A tall rectangular chimney made from warm tan brick rises near the center-left of the main roof and has a flat black cap. Three front-facing gabled dormers project from the main roof. Each dormer is covered with dark horizontal siding and contains a black-framed divided window. The largest dormer is positioned on the right side.  A large front-facing gable forms the left wing of the house. It has vertical siding and narrow decorative trim beneath the roof peak. Another projecting gabled section stands on the far right and contains a large black-framed rectangular window.  A long covered porch extends across most of the front facade. The porch roof is supported by thick natural wood posts with square bases and diagonal wooden braces. The wood has a warm honey-brown tone and visible grain. The porch ceiling is also covered with warm wood boards and contains a row of small recessed lights.  The facade beneath the porch has black-framed windows divided into many square glass panes. A dark front door with multiple glass panels is positioned near the center. Several traditional wall lanterns cast warm light across the dark siding.  Two black wooden rocking chairs with pale patterned cushions stand on the right side of the porch. A small dark table is placed between them. The left section of the porch is mostly open.  The raised porch has a pale concrete floor. Its base and the broad front steps are built from mixed red, cream, and brown brick. A smooth pale concrete walkway leads from the lower-left foreground toward the steps.  The garden contains green lawn, narrow beds of white gravel, low rounded shrubs, and a large clump of tall dry ornamental grass beside the right corner of the porch. Small dark planting beds follow the base of the house. Bare mature trees and a few remaining brown autumn leaves fill the background. Pale gray overcast sky, soft natural daylight, and warm light visible through the windows.

presets.title: Stone Glass Cantilever
presets.summary: Long pale bands, wood, and glass layer into a generous modern villa.
presets.prompt: Wide front-left view of a large two-story house made from long horizontal rectangular volumes. The house has completely flat roofs, deep overhangs, pale stone walls, white roof bands, warm wood surfaces, and extensive floor-to-ceiling glass.  The lower level forms a wide L-shaped composition. Tall solid wall sections on the far left and far right are covered with large pale cream limestone panels. Thick smooth white horizontal roof bands project beyond the glass walls and create shaded terraces.  The left section contains a large open living area behind floor-to-ceiling black-framed glass. Pale seating, a low table, curtains, and warm neutral interior surfaces are visible inside. A large wall section beside this room is covered with horizontal warm brown wood boards.  A second glass room occupies the right corner. Tall black-framed windows wrap around two sides of the corner beneath a broad white roof overhang. Additional horizontal wood cladding covers the walls and ceiling inside the sheltered corner. Pale furniture and interior rooms are visible through the glass.  A taller central upper floor rises above the lower roof. It is framed by pale stone end walls and has a long continuous row of tall dark-framed windows. A narrow warm wood soffit runs above the upper windows. The glass reflects the surrounding trees.  The front garden is arranged with straight geometric lines. Several broad pale stone steps rise from the foreground to the main terrace. A low rectangular pale stone wall stands beside the steps. On the left is a shallow rectangular basin with a dark surface, surrounded by thick white edges.  Large square pale concrete slabs form a path across the lower-right foreground. Narrow strips of small light gravel separate the slabs. Additional rectangular areas of white gravel lie between the steps and terraces. Neatly cut green lawn surrounds the paving.  Low green shrubs and ground-cover plants grow along the base of the house and around the white retaining walls. Large mature trees surround the property. A wide dark tree trunk and spreading branches frame the upper-left corner, while another leafy tree fills the upper-right side. Clear pale blue sky, warm daytime sunlight, and soft moving shadows from the tree leaves across the white walls.

presets.title: Arched Stone Manor
presets.summary: Pale masonry, black details, and sculpted roofs form a contemporary manor.
presets.prompt: Wide front-left view of a large two-and-a-half-story residence surrounded by mature trees. The exterior walls are covered with pale beige and light gray rectangular natural stone. The house has a complex dark roof made from several steep gables, curved sections, and a tall hipped tower roof. All roof edges, gutters, columns, railings, doors, and window frames are black.  The left side contains a wide two-car garage. The garage door is flat black and has four groups of small rectangular glass panels along the upper section. Warm wall lanterns are mounted on the stone walls beside the garage. A tall stone chimney rises behind the left roof and is topped with a wide black cap.  Above the garage is a large front-facing gable with thick black trim. A wide rectangular black-framed window is centered in the stone gable. The lower edge of this section is covered by a curved dark slate roof that sweeps downward toward the left side.  The main entrance is near the center beneath a projecting balcony. The entrance has a wide black front door with narrow vertical glass sidelights. Two square black columns support the balcony and frame the doorway. Warm recessed lights are installed beneath the balcony roof. Pale steps create a small raised entrance platform, with dark planters placed near the columns.  The balcony has a black metal railing with thin vertical bars. Black-framed glass doors open onto the balcony, and a warm wood wall is visible behind them. A small roof overhang with recessed lighting covers this upper entrance.  The right side rises into a tall square tower covered with matching pale stone. A large arched black-framed window occupies the middle of the tower. Below it are tall black-framed glass doors and windows showing warmly lit interior rooms. A rectangular window is placed higher on the tower wall.  The tower is covered with a steep dark hipped roof. A small arched dormer projects from the front roof slope and is surrounded by thick curved black trim. A second smaller arched dormer is visible near the center roof section.  A broad driveway fills most of the foreground. It is paved with large rectangular stone slabs in varied shades of light gray, warm beige, and muted blue-gray. The slabs form an irregular geometric pattern.  Formal planting beds follow both sides of the driveway. They are covered with dark mulch and contain rows of low round shrubs, small mounded evergreens, tall narrow conifer trees, and young ornamental trees. A large curved planting island occupies the right foreground. Small landscape lights illuminate the trees and shrubs from below.  Dense tall hedges and mature birch trees surround the property. The sky is pale blue-gray near evening. Warm light glows from the windows, wall lanterns, entrance ceiling, and garden lights.

presets.title: Concrete Courtyard Frame
presets.summary: Massive board-formed planes surround a warm recessed entrance.
presets.prompt: Wide front-left street-level view of a large contemporary house built from exposed light gray concrete. The house stands on a gently sloping site and is composed of several massive rectangular volumes with flat roofs. The concrete surfaces show horizontal formwork seams, subtle natural color variations, and small circular tie holes.  The main entrance is placed inside a very large open rectangular concrete frame near the center. A thick roof slab and a tall right-side wall create a deep covered entrance terrace. The underside of the concrete roof is flat and contains several small warm recessed lights.  At the back of the entrance terrace is a tall wall covered with narrow vertical reddish-brown wood slats. A large wooden entrance door is integrated into this surface. To the left of the wood wall is a floor-to-ceiling glass section with thin black frames. Warm interior lighting, dark shelves, and reflective glass surfaces are visible inside.  A broad pale stone terrace extends across the front of the entrance. Three wide shallow steps descend toward the sidewalk. Warm linear lights are hidden beneath the edges of the steps, creating glowing horizontal bands.  The left side of the house contains several smaller concrete blocks at different depths. A narrow vertical opening between the blocks reveals a warmly lit interior. Small ground lights illuminate the tall concrete walls from below.  The house continues down the slope on the right as a long lower wing. This section has another thick concrete frame and large floor-to-ceiling glass walls. Warm interior light is visible through the windows.  Low rectangular concrete planters are integrated into the architecture. They contain small slender trees, soft green shrubs, ornamental grasses, and low ground-cover plants. Warm landscape lights shine upward onto the plants and concrete walls. A narrow strip of green lawn follows the right edge of the property.  A dark gray paved street runs diagonally across the lower-right foreground. The sky is filled with soft blue-gray clouds, with pale pink and orange light near the left horizon. Early evening atmosphere with warm architectural lighting contrasting against the cool sky.

presets.title: Snowline White Villa
presets.summary: Interlocking white volumes stand crisply against a quiet winter landscape.
presets.prompt: Wide front-left view of a two-story contemporary house in a quiet winter landscape. The house is composed of several overlapping white rectangular volumes with completely flat roofs and thick horizontal roof edges. The exterior walls are smooth white and pale gray, combined with dark gray stone and black metal window frames.  The main ground-floor living area has large floor-to-ceiling glass walls wrapping around the front corner. Thin black frames divide the glass into tall rectangular panels. A warm interior with pale walls, dark furniture, a table lamp, artwork, and simple hanging lights is visible through the windows.  A second smaller glass section stands on the far left behind a white rectangular frame. Light gray curtains hang inside. The upper floor is set back above the main living area and has a long horizontal corner window beneath a thick white roof slab.  A broad white roof band extends across the front and continues toward the right wing. Small warm recessed lights are evenly placed beneath the overhang. The entrance is recessed on the right side behind a dark gray wall and a white rectangular column.  A tall rectangular chimney covered with narrow horizontal gray stone rises near the center-right of the house. The chimney is topped by a wide open black metal cap.  The house stands on a raised gray terrace surrounded by low white and gray retaining walls. A straight flight of broad gray steps rises from the foreground to the glass living room. A second shorter set of steps is visible near the right side. Small warm lights are installed near the lower steps.  A large rounded green shrub stands on the raised terrace near the entrance. Rows of low rounded bushes follow the base of the house and are lightly covered with fresh white snow. Snow also covers the lawn, retaining walls, and edges of the path.  A gray driveway made from small rectangular pavers runs along the lower-right foreground. A massive dark tree trunk frames the left side of the image. Tall bare trees and frost-covered branches fill the background. Soft pale winter daylight with warm light glowing from the interior.

presets.title: Forest Glass Pavilion
presets.summary: A low concrete canopy shelters a transparent home at the edge of the woods.
presets.prompt: Wide straight-on view of a long single-story house surrounded by a dense green forest. The house is built from exposed pale gray concrete and forms a low horizontal pavilion with a continuous floor-to-ceiling glass facade.  A massive concrete roof slab extends far beyond the building on the left, creating a dramatic floating canopy. The underside of the canopy shows large rectangular concrete panels and natural formwork lines. Its inner edge has an angular geometric shape before connecting to the long horizontal roof slab that continues across the rest of the house.  The main facade is almost completely transparent. Thin black metal frames divide the glass into large vertical panels. The glass reflects the surrounding trees while allowing the rooms inside to remain clearly visible.  The left interior contains a quiet sitting or sleeping area with a low pale sofa or bed. A warm wood wall stands behind it, illuminated by a concealed horizontal light. A small dark side table and simple wall artwork are visible.  Near the center is a dining table with several dark chairs and a hanging lamp with a warm shade. Behind it is a dark kitchen wall with black cabinets, shelves, and a long counter. The right side contains more wood surfaces, a long table or bench, pale curtains, and several indoor plants.  The house rests on a broad elevated concrete platform. A large open terrace extends across the front of the glass facade. A low rounded beige sculptural lounge chair stands on the terrace near the left-center. Several simple rectangular steps descend from the platform.  A dark shadow gap is visible beneath parts of the elevated house. Below the terrace is a narrow garden bed containing ferns, rounded shrubs, and low leafy plants. Large pale concrete slabs form geometric paths across the foreground, separated by narrow strips of fine gravel and grass.  Tall mature trees rise closely around the building and form a dense green background. Large branches frame the upper-right side. Warm sunlight enters from the right and creates long soft shadows across the concrete terrace and garden.

presets.title: Desert Courtyard House
presets.summary: Concrete, stone, and warm timber frame a dry planted garden.
presets.prompt: Wide centered front view of a low single-story house surrounded by a dry garden and mature trees. The architecture combines pale exposed concrete, rough natural stone, warm horizontal wood cladding, black-framed glass, and completely flat roofs.  A thick pale concrete rectangular frame surrounds the main right side of the facade. Its roof projects forward to create a deep covered terrace. Small warm recessed lights are evenly placed beneath the overhang.  The right side has a large floor-to-ceiling glass wall with thin black frames. A warmly lit living room is fully visible through the glass. Inside are a pale beige sofa, a dark wooden coffee table, a side table, a large floor lamp with a cream shade, indoor plants, and a large dark artwork. A rough natural stone wall continues through the interior behind the furniture.  Near the center-left is a tall rectangular volume covered with horizontal dark brown wood boards. A simple black wall light casts warm light upward and downward across the wood. A large potted green plant stands at the base of this wall.  Behind the wooden volume is a recessed entrance passage. The ceiling of the passage is covered with warm wood and contains two straight rows of small recessed lights. A reddish-brown framed glass entrance door stands at the back. Through the entrance, another outdoor landscape is visible on the opposite side of the house.  Large walls made from irregular pale gray and warm beige stone blocks stand on the left and rise above the roof on the right. A rectangular stone chimney projects above the right side of the building.  A broad flight of pale concrete steps leads directly toward the entrance. The front garden is covered with light gravel and contains large smooth rounded gray boulders. Tall columnar cacti grow on the left beside the stone wall. The right garden contains agaves, blue-green succulents, a small ribbed cactus, and low desert plants.  A large mature tree with a thick twisting trunk stands in the left foreground. Its branches and green leaves stretch across the top of the image. Small landscape lights illuminate the cacti, boulders, plants, and stone walls. Soft early evening light with a warm glow coming from the house.

presets.title: Monolithic Concrete Wall
presets.summary: Two long concrete blocks create a severe and private street elevation.
presets.prompt: Wide street-level view of a large minimalist house dominated by a long blank wall made from exposed gray concrete. The building is composed of two massive horizontal concrete volumes with almost no visible windows.  The upper volume is a very large elongated rectangular block extending across most of the image. It projects beyond the lower level and appears to float above the entrance area. The concrete surface shows large horizontal and vertical formwork divisions, subtle gray stains, natural tonal variation, and evenly spaced circular tie holes.  A second lower concrete wall runs across the center and right side of the facade. A narrow horizontal shadow gap separates parts of the upper and lower volumes. The walls have sharp straight edges and simple flat rooflines.  The entrance is positioned near the far-left side beneath the projecting upper block. It is reached by a pale stone path and several shallow steps. The opening is framed with dark metal and contains a tall bronze-colored or warm brown vertical wall panel. Soft amber light shines across this panel and illuminates the concrete ceiling and entrance floor.  A dark lower base supports the glass entrance section. Only a small part of the interior is visible through the narrow opening. Several small ground lights are placed along the entrance path.  Dark green climbing plants grow irregularly across the base of the long lower concrete wall. A broad planted strip in front contains low gray-green shrubs, dense ground cover, and a narrow band of small beige gravel.  A young slender tree stands on the right side of the garden. A warm ground light illuminates its trunk and yellow-green leaves from below. A dark trimmed hedge continues behind the tree. Another simple geometric building volume is partly visible on the far right.  A small square exterior light stands near the left edge of the gravel bed. A pale concrete curb separates the garden from the dark asphalt street in the foreground. Calm blue evening sky with soft blurred clouds and gentle warm lighting near the entrance and tree.

presets.title: Mottled Forest House
presets.summary: A quiet cement volume stretches along the edge of dense woodland.
presets.prompt: A wide exterior architectural photograph of a long modern house standing at the edge of a dense forest. The building is a simple rectangular volume with a flat roof and a very tall, almost completely solid upper facade. The exterior walls are finished with uneven mottled gray cement plaster, with subtle cloudy variations across the surface. A thin dark metal line runs along the roof edge.  The left front corner of the house is close to the camera, and the long facade recedes deeply toward the right side of the frame. Along the lower part of the facade is one continuous row of floor-to-ceiling glass panels and sliding glass doors with thin dark gray metal frames.  Through the glass, show a bright minimalist interior with pale floors and warm white lighting. On the left is a long low gray cabinet with flat doors, two tall vertical abstract paintings above it, a small white table lamp, and a small dark plant pot. Behind it is a simple kitchen area with pale wood cabinets and a small sink. Place a dark dining table with several simple chairs near the glass. In the center of the house is a large white sculptural spiral staircase with smooth curved surfaces. Farther to the right, show a darker living area, a few pieces of furniture, wall art, and reflections of the surrounding trees in the glass.  A broad freshly cut green lawn fills the foreground and follows the full length of the house. The grass has clear parallel mowing lines. A narrow dark paved path runs beside the left wall. Tall pine trees and dense deciduous trees surround the building on all sides. The sky is pale blue and gray with soft scattered clouds. Cool soft daylight outside, warm interior light behind the glass. Eye-level camera positioned near the front-left corner, wide horizontal composition, straight vertical lines, quiet empty scene.

presets.title: White Garden House
presets.summary: Crisp flat-roofed rooms open through black-framed glass to a designed garden.
presets.prompt: A wide exterior architectural photograph of a small modern flat-roofed house surrounded by a carefully landscaped garden. The house is composed of several connected white rectangular volumes with clean edges, black metal window frames, and large floor-to-ceiling glass walls.  On the right side is a large solid white concrete box. Its front wall contains a precise rectangular grid of deep circular openings. The openings are evenly spaced in straight rows and columns. Some circles are dark, while others show warm orange light coming from inside the building. The white concrete surface has faint vertical seams and a slightly weathered texture.  In the center-left is a tall glass living room with large black-framed windows divided into rectangular sections. The interior glows with deep warm amber light. Through the glass, show a light-colored sofa, cushions, a low table, a small fireplace opening, a floor lamp, and a delicate hanging sculptural light. Light curtains hang beside the glass.  On the far left is a deep white rectangular entrance portal. A large dark wooden door stands open inside the portal, with a view through to a small rear courtyard. A warm ceiling light is visible above the entrance.  A pale concrete walkway begins in the foreground, bends gently through the garden, and leads toward the entrance. The planting beds are covered with dark reddish-brown mulch. Include a large spiky yucca plant in the right foreground, smaller agave-like plants, low ornamental grasses, compact shrubs, and a sculpted evergreen bush on the left. A smooth green lawn occupies the right side of the garden.  Surround the property with mature leafy trees and several very tall narrow cypress trees. A dark wooden fence runs behind the house, and a simple utility pole is visible among the trees. Late-afternoon sunlight comes through the foliage. The sky is pale blue with long thin white clouds stretching horizontally. Eye-level camera, frontal three-quarter view, wide horizontal composition, warm illuminated interior against the cooler garden.

presets.title: Concrete Lawn Pavilion
presets.summary: A continuous glass facade rests beneath one powerful horizontal slab.
presets.prompt: A straight-on wide exterior architectural photograph of a long low concrete house viewed across a flat green lawn. The building has a strong horizontal shape and is centered in the frame.  A thick pale gray exposed-concrete roof slab extends almost across the full width of the image. The slab projects outward and creates a deep shaded canopy over the glass facade. The concrete has a soft rough texture with faint seams and natural variations in tone. Above the main roof line are several low rectangular concrete volumes arranged at different heights, creating a stepped silhouette against the trees.  Below the concrete canopy, most of the facade is made from continuous floor-to-ceiling glass with very thin dark metal frames. The glass is dark and reflective, showing subtle reflections of the garden and trees. Dark charcoal walls frame the glass facade at both ends.  Through the glass, show an open interior. On the left is a long beige sofa with several tan cushions, a low dark table, and a few small dark chairs. In the center is a simple rectangular block made from pale stone. On the right is a long wooden kitchen or dining counter with several stools. Behind the counter is a dark wall with a row of warm illuminated shelves displaying small objects and pottery. Keep the interior lighting soft and subdued.  A broad rectangular lawn fills the lower foreground. Dense natural garden beds border both sides of the house. On the left, include tall green stems, leafy shrubs, ornamental grasses, and many small purple, pink, red, and white flowers. On the right, include white flowering plants, reeds, grasses, and mixed green shrubs. A young slender tree stands close to the right edge of the frame.  Behind the house is a dense layer of mature trees with broad irregular crowns. The sky is pale and lightly overcast. Soft diffused daylight, muted natural colors, very gentle shadows. Symmetrical frontal composition, eye-level camera, wide horizontal framing, the complete facade visible from end to end.

presets.title: Board-Formed Desert House
presets.summary: Heavy concrete cantilevers settle into a dry natural landscape.
presets.prompt: A wide exterior architectural photograph of a large modern house made from exposed board-formed concrete. The house stands in a dry natural landscape with low hills, scattered shrubs, grasses, and mature trees.  The architecture is formed by heavy horizontal concrete slabs, thick walls, long cantilevered sections, and large open rectangular frames. Two tall concrete box-like structures rise at the far left and far right sides of the house. A long upper concrete beam stretches across almost the entire building and creates a deep shaded area below. The concrete surfaces show horizontal marks left by wooden formwork, small holes, seams, and warm natural variations in color.  A mature tree with a thick dark trunk grows inside the central courtyard and rises through the open structure. Its broad crown appears above the long concrete beam. A narrow horizontal window is visible on the upper level behind the concrete walls.  The ground floor contains large floor-to-ceiling glass walls and sliding glass doors with thin dark metal frames. Through the glass room on the left, show a simple bed with pale bedding and long neutral curtains. In the central and right sections, show quiet interior spaces with minimal furniture, soft curtains, and reflections of the surrounding landscape.  A large pale stone terrace extends across the foreground. Place two low wooden sun loungers near the center, facing a rectangular swimming pool on the right. The pool contains deep blue-green water and reflects the concrete walls, sky, and warm sunlight. A long wooden outdoor dining table with matching chairs stands at the far right end of the terrace.  On the left side of the house is a narrow area covered with small black gravel. Around the terrace are dry golden grasses, low shrubs, small olive-like trees, and scattered natural planting. Soft rolling hills are visible in the distance.  Warm low sunlight comes from the right and gives the concrete a golden beige tone. Long gentle shadows fall across the terrace. Pale blue sky with a few soft white clouds. Eye-level camera positioned near the corner of the swimming pool, front-left three-quarter view of the house, wide horizontal composition, strong straight lines and deep architectural shadows.

presets.title: Wood Box Street House
presets.summary: A dark timber upper volume crowns a precise white street facade.
presets.prompt: A straight-on exterior architectural photograph of a compact modern house with a closed geometric street facade. The building is centered beneath a large clear blue sky.  The lower floor is a wide white stucco rectangle with a flat roof and a thick clean frame around one deep horizontal recess. The white surface is smooth and bright. Inside the dark recess, place a large matte black sectional garage door on the left. The garage door has wide horizontal panels with subtle surface variations.  To the right of the garage is a protected entrance area. A pale raw-concrete privacy wall stands in front of the entrance. The concrete wall has visible panel seams and small circular form-tie holes. Above it is a narrow dark opening with a small reddish-brown mesh panel. On the right side of the entrance is a screen made from evenly spaced vertical warm wooden slats. Behind the screen, show a dark shaded passage and part of a wood-covered ceiling.  Above the white lower volume is a smaller rectangular upper floor positioned near the center. It is clad with dark brown vertical wooden boards with natural variations in tone. Place one small square black-framed window slightly left of the center of this wooden volume. The window projects slightly outward and reflects the blue sky.  A pale concrete driveway enters from the lower-left corner and leads to the black garage door. In front of the house is a dry landscaped garden covered with reddish-brown mulch. Include loose groups of tall thin ornamental grasses, small round gray-green grass plants, several natural stones, and one larger tan boulder near the concrete entrance wall.  Place a low rectangular raw-concrete address wall in the front-right part of the garden. Add dark metal house numbers reading “10385” on its front surface. A mature pine tree fills much of the right side of the frame, while smaller leafy trees appear behind the left side of the house. Small parts of neighboring buildings and dark side fences are visible near the edges.  Bright clear daylight, soft directional shadows, natural contrast between white stucco, black metal, raw concrete, and dark wood. Eye-level camera directly facing the house, wide horizontal composition, straight architectural lines, large open area of blue sky above the roof.

presets.title: Raised Concrete Terrace
presets.summary: A long elevated concrete home projects over a restrained garden.
presets.prompt: A wide exterior architectural photograph of a low modern house built from pale exposed concrete. The main living floor is raised above the ground and forms one long horizontal rectangular volume with a flat roof. A low concrete parapet runs along the roof, with a thin strip of dry grass growing near the edge. A small metal roof vent is visible near the right side.  The upper facade is divided into several distinct sections. On the far left is a large solid wall covered with narrow vertical concrete ribs. Next to it is a recessed floor-to-ceiling glass wall opening onto a narrow balcony. The balcony has a simple dark metal railing made from thin horizontal bars. Through the glass, show a quiet living area with a light-colored sofa, small plants, and minimal furniture.  The central part of the upper floor is an open glass-fronted living and dining space. Large sliding glass panels with thin gray metal frames connect the interior to the terrace. Show several green plants near the opening, a wooden dining table with mixed chairs, dark ceiling lights, and a modern kitchen behind it. The kitchen has warm wooden cabinets, a dark central column, a counter with stools, and simple hanging lamps.  On the right is another large sliding glass wall with a pale kitchen counter visible behind it. At the far right, inside a deep shaded niche, place a row of matte black outdoor kitchen cabinets with a metal grill. The upper floor is protected by a thick projecting concrete roof slab.  A broad concrete staircase rises from the lower level to the central terrace. To the right of the stairs is a tall solid exposed-concrete retaining wall with evenly spaced circular form-tie marks. In front of the staircase is a long low cantilevered concrete platform with a rectangular geometric shape.  The lower floor is partly open. Show a covered carport supported by square concrete columns, a small wooden worktable against the back wall, and a dark garage opening in the center with a black car parked inside. On the far left, place a dark green open-top vintage off-road vehicle near the edge of the driveway.  The driveway is made from long parallel concrete strips separated by narrow lines of green grass. Dense tropical planting fills the foreground, including large split leaves, ferns, low shrubs, and layered green groundcover. A few purple flowers appear near the left side. A mature tree extends into the frame from the right.  Clear deep blue sky without clouds, strong direct daylight, crisp shadows, natural pale concrete surfaces, dark glass reflections, and rich green vegetation. Camera at street level, facing the house almost directly, slightly below the raised living floor, wide horizontal composition.

presets.title: Black White Cascade
presets.summary: Contrasting boxes and broad stairs climb a terraced modern site.
presets.prompt: A wide exterior architectural photograph of a large two-story modern house made from interlocking white and black rectangular volumes. The house stands above a terraced garden and is viewed from a low position near the bottom of a broad outdoor staircase.  On the right, create a large projecting upper floor wrapped inside a thick white rectangular frame. The white roof and floor slabs extend far beyond the glass walls, forming a strong cantilever. The corner of the upper floor is enclosed with continuous floor-to-ceiling glass, thin black frames, and a transparent glass balcony railing. Warm recessed ceiling lights are evenly distributed across the underside of the white roof.  Below this projecting volume is a covered outdoor terrace. Use black structural columns, floor-to-ceiling glass walls, and wide sliding doors. Show a dark outdoor kitchen island beneath the canopy, with warm lighting inside the rooms behind it. Place a long low suspended wooden bench near the far-right edge of the terrace.  The left half of the house is formed by darker black volumes. A broad dark gray roof projects over a tall two-story glass section. Cover the underside of this roof with narrow warm brown wooden boards running lengthwise. Add several small recessed lights to the wood ceiling. The tall central facade contains large glass panels separated by thick black vertical columns.  On the lower left is a black-framed glass living room. Through the windows, show a long pale sofa, a dining area, dark furniture, and warm interior lighting. Above this room is an open terrace with a clear glass railing and a matte black horizontal base. Behind the terrace, show tall glass doors and the warm wooden ceiling continuing inside.  Connect the different volumes with a narrow central vertical section of black cladding and glass. A slender young tree with light green leaves grows directly in front of this central section and reaches toward the second floor.  A broad sequence of pale concrete steps rises through the foreground toward the house. The steps are arranged in several staggered groups with wide landings. Surround them with raw concrete retaining walls, natural rocks, low green shrubs, groundcover plants, and small garden lights. Warm light from the fixtures illuminates a few plants beside the steps.  Dense mature trees surround the house and fill the background on the right. A few branches enter from the top-right corner. The sky is a soft cool blue at dusk. The exterior is evenly lit by the fading daylight, while warm ceiling lights and interior lights glow through the glass. Camera facing the projecting corner of the house from the lower garden, slightly looking upward, wide horizontal composition.

presets.title: Sloped Box House
presets.summary: Stacked gray and timber volumes adapt a modern home to rising ground.
presets.prompt: A wide street-level exterior view of a modern multi-level house built on a sloping site. The architecture is composed of several stacked rectangular boxes with flat roofs, deep recesses, strong cantilevers, and a restrained palette of gray concrete, horizontal gray cladding, and dark reddish-brown vertical panels.  The upper floor is a large rectangular box positioned near the center and left side of the house. Cover it with narrow horizontal gray stone or concrete strips, creating a layered linear texture. The front-left part of this upper box contains a deep rectangular opening with dark floor-to-ceiling glass set far back in shadow. The upper volume projects outward above the lower floors.  Below it, on the left, place a large closed rectangular volume clad with narrow vertical reddish-brown panels. The same vertical cladding continues around its side. Next to this volume is a tall plain gray concrete wall that creates a solid transition toward the center of the house.  On the right is a long sheltered terrace enclosed by a thick gray rectangular concrete frame. The roof projects outward and creates a deep shadow over the terrace. Cover the back wall of the terrace with dark reddish-brown vertical slats. Add a simple long horizontal railing along the open edge and a narrow bench-like element inside the shaded space.  A lower floor is visible beneath the right terrace. It is recessed into the slope and finished with dark vertical panels. Create a partially open carport near the lower-right corner. Show two cars partly hidden beneath the house, one dark vehicle and one white vehicle.  The house sits above an inclined street. A pale paved sidewalk follows the curved edge of the dark asphalt road in the foreground. A low curb separates the road from the landscape. Pale stone steps rise through the planting near the center-left and lead from the sidewalk toward the entrance.  Cover the sloping garden with dense groups of large broad-leaf green plants. The plants form a continuous low layer along the entire base of the house. Include several small slender trees with light green and yellow-green leaves in front of the building. A low natural stone retaining wall appears behind the cars on the right. Mature leafy trees create a dense background around the property.  Soft warm late-afternoon sunlight touches the gray and brown surfaces. The shadows beneath the projecting volumes are deep but natural.
