Pale blue sky with soft white clouds, no people, calm residential street. Camera positioned across the road, looking slightly upward at the house, wide horizontal composition with the full building and sloping landscape visible.

presets.title: Garden A-Frame
presets.summary: A crisp triangular frame gives a glass-fronted house graphic symmetry.
presets.prompt: A direct frontal exterior architectural photograph of a tall two-story A-frame house standing in a landscaped garden. The building is perfectly centered and has a strong symmetrical triangular shape.  Create one large white triangular structural frame with very thick sloping sides meeting at a sharp high point. The white surfaces are smooth and clean. The deep interior surfaces beneath the sloping roof have a warm beige tone, with sections of natural wood visible near the upper ceiling.  The upper floor is set inside the top half of the triangle. Fill the triangular opening with tall floor-to-ceiling glass panels framed by narrow black metal mullions. A strong central black vertical frame rises toward the pointed roof. The glass follows the triangular roof shape and reflects the pale sky and surrounding trees.  Place a recessed balcony across the lower part of the upper floor. The balcony has a transparent frameless glass railing and a white horizontal floor slab. Add small green plants in dark planters near both corners of the balcony. Through the upper glass, show a light open interior with a few pale pieces of furniture and warm wood surfaces.  The lower floor sits beneath the balcony inside a wide trapezoid-shaped opening. Cover most of the facade with full-height sliding glass doors divided by thin black vertical frames. The glass reflects the garden while still revealing a warm neutral living room.  Inside the lower level, arrange several light beige lounge chairs, low sofas, small tables, and neutral cushions. Place a sculptural branching pendant light near the right side. Add several large round white ceramic planters with green plants beside the right sloping wall. On the left, show light curtains and a few simple lounge chairs. The large sloping structural sides remain visible inside the room.  A wide set of shallow white steps extends across the full width of the house and descends toward the lawn. In front of the steps, place several large pale rectangular paving slabs separated by narrow strips of green grass.  A smooth green lawn fills the foreground. Surround the house with layered garden planting: low ornamental grasses, broad-leaf plants, compact rounded shrubs, flowering groundcover, and dense mature trees on both sides. Keep the area immediately in front of the house open so the triangular form remains clearly visible. Dark leafy branches enter the upper-left corner of the frame.  Soft warm sunlight comes from the right and creates gentle shadows across the lawn and white structure. The sky is pale blue with very light haze. Eye-level camera directly facing the center of the house, strict symmetrical composition, wide horizontal frame, the entire triangular facade visible from the lawn to the pointed roof.

presets.title: Hillside Concrete Gable
presets.summary: A low pitched concrete residence is embedded in a wooded slope.
presets.prompt: A wide frontal exterior view of a two-level modern concrete house built into a steep wooded hillside. The house is centered in the frame and has a low, wide triangular profile. A shallow pitched roof rises to a central ridge and slopes down toward both sides. The roof has thin gray metal edges and long projecting eaves. The exterior walls are made from smooth medium-gray concrete.  The upper floor rests on a long horizontal concrete balcony slab. Most of the upper facade is covered with floor-to-ceiling glass divided by thin gray metal frames. The glass follows the shape of the sloping roof, creating large rectangular panels in the center and trapezoid-shaped panels near the sides. Solid angled concrete walls close the outer ends of the facade.  A narrow balcony runs across the upper level. Use a simple railing made from thin metal posts and horizontal cables. Through the glass, show a warm open living and dining space. In the center and right side, place a wooden dining table with several bright orange-red chairs. Add hanging pendant lights, shelves, framed wall art, indoor plants, and a few small decorative objects. On the left side, show a quieter room with a chair and soft warm ceiling light. Reflections of the surrounding trees appear across the large windows.  The lower level is recessed beneath the balcony slab and partially built into the slope. In the center is a wide wall of sliding glass doors. Behind the glass, show a warmly illuminated living room with neutral furniture, a low table, and a large colorful abstract painting on the right wall. Place two dark ceramic planters with plants on both sides of the glass entrance.  Large angled concrete walls extend outward from the lower level and hold back the earth on both sides. Add two warm wall lights to the concrete facade. A broad courtyard made from rectangular gray and muted red paving stones fills the center of the foreground. Several shallow steps lead down from the courtyard toward the camera.  On the right side of the courtyard is a small geometric pond enclosed by low concrete walls. Place dark rocks and a small vertical fountain in the water. A narrow channel follows the edge of the pond. Use low concrete retaining walls to organize the sloping garden around the courtyard.  Cover the surrounding ground with dark reddish-brown mulch, native grasses, agave-like plants, compact shrubs, and scattered natural rocks. Add small garden lights among the plants. A path of separate pale stepping stones climbs the slope on the left side of the house.  A large pale eucalyptus tree trunk dominates the left foreground and extends beyond the top edge of the image. The background is a steep natural hillside covered with eucalyptus trees, dense dark foliage, dry grass, and uneven ground. Early evening light with a cool blue tone outside and warm yellow-orange light inside the house. Camera facing the building directly from the lower courtyard, slightly looking upward, wide horizontal composition.

presets.title: Rolling Hills Shell House
presets.summary: Curved overlapping shells form an organic home in open green country.
presets.prompt: A high three-quarter exterior view of a large organic house standing alone in an open landscape of endless rolling green hills. The building has a flowing asymmetrical shape with almost no straight outer edges. Its form is created by several large curved shells and ribbon-like surfaces that overlap and wrap around the house.  Cover most of the exterior with narrow vertical wooden boards in a warm honey-brown tone. The wood follows every curve of the building and forms smooth continuous surfaces around the walls, balconies, and roof edges. Combine the wood with large areas of matte black metal and black vertical cladding.  The main roof is a broad curved black standing-seam metal surface rising over the rear and right side of the building. Its shape bends gently like a soft wave. Add several long narrow skylights following the roof slope, along with a few smaller oval and circular roof openings.  A large wooden ribbon begins near the rounded front-left corner, rises over the building, and creates a high curved arch above an upper terrace. Beneath this arch, show a long recessed balcony with a transparent glass railing. Place dark-framed windows and warm wooden walls behind the balcony.  Create several large irregular openings across the facade. The openings have smooth rounded corners and shapes similar to long ovals, stretched teardrops, and curved triangles. Use thin dark frames around the glass. On the front-left corner, place a broad recessed terrace inside a long horizontal opening. Add a transparent glass railing and dark flooring. Behind it, show full-height sliding glass doors, wood-paneled interior walls, a simple floor lamp, and minimal furniture.  In the center of the house, add a tall group of dark-framed windows between flowing black and wooden surfaces. Through the windows, show warm interior lighting, light-colored furniture, wooden floors, and thin linear ceiling lights. Above the windows, a narrow curved wooden band follows the organic shape of the facade.  On the right side, create another deep curved opening containing a covered balcony and the main entrance. A dark outdoor floor rises toward a recessed doorway. Use a simple black glass railing along the edge. A broad wooden band passes diagonally above this opening and continues around the side of the house.  A straight light gravel path enters from the bottom-right corner and leads toward the entrance. Place a small landscaped strip beside the path with pale gravel, compact shrubs, and several blue-green agave plants. The rest of the site is covered with natural meadow grass.  The building stands within a vast open prairie with soft green hills extending to the distant horizon. A winding blue river passes through the landscape in the left background. A thin line of small trees follows parts of the river. Clear pale blue sky, bright soft daylight, gentle natural shadows. Camera positioned high above the front-left side of the house, looking slightly downward, with the full building and distant landscape visible.

presets.title: Orbital White Villa
presets.summary: Rounded white wings and black sculptural frames create a futuristic residence.
presets.prompt: A wide front three-quarter exterior view of a large futuristic two-story villa composed of white rounded rectangular volumes and dramatic black sculptural frames. The building has broad cantilevered wings, smooth curved corners, large glass walls, and deep open terraces.  On the left side, create a long white upper-floor volume projecting far beyond the ground floor. Give it thick smooth walls and softly rounded outer corners. Cut a large horizontal rounded rectangular opening into its front. Inside the opening, place dark floor-to-ceiling glass and a long planter filled with green plants. Continue a planted roof edge above this volume.  On the right side, create a larger white two-story volume with a high rounded rectangular frame. The upper floor contains a deep recessed terrace with a black ceiling, dark glass walls, and a continuous planter filled with green tropical plants. Trace the inside edge of the opening with a thin warm light strip. Extend the white upper volume outward to create a strong cantilever above the ground floor.  The ground floor is mostly enclosed with large floor-to-ceiling glass walls divided by thin black frames. Through the glass, show dark modern interiors, pale sofas, warm ceiling lights, and reflections of the landscape. Use black angled structural supports beneath parts of the white upper floor.  Make the central entrance the main visual feature. Place a large asymmetrical black frame in front of the house. The frame has thick folded sides, rounded corners, and a slightly leaning geometric shape. Cover it with dark polished stone containing subtle thin white veins. Add a narrow warm light line around the inner edge of the frame.  Behind this black frame, place a tall vertical decorative wall with an irregular honeycomb pattern. The cells are outlined with warm golden light. Surround the lower and side edges of the honeycomb screen with dense vertical green planting. Place narrow black vertical wall panels beside the screen.  Add a second black sculptural frame behind and to the left of the main entrance. It rises diagonally between the two white wings and contains a narrow open space with warm linear lighting. The overlapping black frames create a layered central composition.  Use thin warm light strips across the black terrace ceilings and around the edges of the architectural openings. Add several long angular light lines inside the upper-right terrace. Keep the main exterior surfaces bright white, while the central frames and supporting walls remain deep charcoal black.  Create a broad white terrace across the foreground with long black horizontal inlays. Place wide low steps in the center leading toward the entrance. Arrange pale outdoor lounge sofas and low tables on both sides of the terrace. Add small groups of shrubs, grasses, and green plants near the glass walls.  A long dark reflecting pool fills the bottom foreground and mirrors some of the warm lights. Separate the water from the house with clean white platforms and narrow black lines. Include low garden lights near the steps and planting.  Place a rocky mountain slope and dense trees in the left background. Add a tall palm tree near the right edge and several slender trees behind the house. Pale evening sky with soft blue tones and light pink clouds. Warm architectural lighting contrasts with the cool sky. Low camera position facing the central entrance from slightly left of center, wide horizontal composition.

presets.title: Platinum Stillness
presets.summary: A direct fair-haired portrait with spare styling and quiet intensity.
presets.prompt: A vertical portrait photograph of a young adult woman facing the camera directly. She has very fair skin, long straight platinum-blonde hair with a clean middle part, and the hair falls naturally over both shoulders. Her eyebrows and eyelashes are very light, and her eyes are pale blue-gray. She wears bright deep red lipstick with a clean shape and very little other visible makeup. Her expression is calm, serious, and neutral, with closed lips and a steady gaze into the camera.  She is wearing a loose dark olive-green blouse with a deep V-shaped neckline and a simple chest pocket. The portrait is framed from the middle of the torso upward. Her body and face are centered, photographed at eye level.  The background is a plain warm gray-beige wall without any objects or texture. Soft diffused light falls evenly across her face, creating gentle shadows around the nose, jaw, and neck. The overall color palette is muted and natural, with strong contrast between the pale hair, red lips, olive clothing, and warm neutral background.

presets.title: Olive Studio Gaze
presets.summary: A poised seated portrait shaped by saturated color and precise symmetry.
presets.prompt: A vertical upper-body portrait of a young adult woman sitting directly in front of the camera. She has warm olive skin, green eyes, dark thick eyebrows, and dark brown hair pulled tightly back with a precise middle part. Her hair is smooth and close to the head. She wears small simple stud earrings.  Her makeup includes black winged eyeliner, defined eyelashes, warm peach blush, softly contoured cheeks, and vivid red-orange lipstick. Her lips are slightly parted, and she looks directly into the camera with a focused, serious expression.  She is wearing a smooth bright yellow long-sleeve top with a high round neckline. Her arms are folded across the lower part of the frame, with one hand resting over the opposite forearm.  The background is a plain muted olive-green wall. A narrow vertical band of strong warm yellow sunlight runs down the center of the composition, beginning above her head and continuing across her face, chest, and folded arms. The sides of her face and body fall into darker greenish shadows. The lighting is hard and directional, with clear edges between light and shadow. The composition is centered and symmetrical, with a strong yellow and olive color palette.

presets.title: Sunset Over-Shoulder
presets.summary: Warm rim light catches a relaxed glance among softly blurred trees.
presets.prompt: A vertical outdoor portrait of a young adult woman photographed during sunset. She is turned partly away from the camera and looks back over her shoulder. Her head is gently turned toward the viewer, and she has a soft, relaxed expression with a slight natural smile.  She has warm medium-light skin, dark brown eyes, full dark eyebrows, and shoulder-length dark brown hair. Her hair is loose, slightly wavy, and softly moved by the breeze. Several fine strands cross her face. She wears small round pearl-like stud earrings and a loose gray textured knit sweater with a deep V-shaped neckline.  The setting is outdoors among trees. The low sun is directly behind the left side of her head, producing a bright orange glow, warm rim light around her hair, and small areas of light flare. The background is strongly blurred, with large soft circles of golden sunlight and dark tree shapes.  Her face is softly lit from the front while the sunset creates warm orange edges around her hair and shoulder. The portrait is framed from the upper torso upward. The color palette contains warm amber sunlight, deep brown hair, natural skin tones, and cool gray clothing.

presets.title: Monochrome Leather Pose
presets.summary: A diagonal black-and-white composition with a strong editorial gesture.
presets.prompt: A vertical black-and-white portrait of a young adult woman leaning forward over a dark leather chair or sofa. Her body is positioned diagonally across the frame. One arm stretches horizontally in front of her, resting on the furniture, while the other arm bends downward and supports her pose. Her long forearms create strong graphic lines through the composition.  She has dark hair pulled tightly into a smooth bun with a middle part. She wears a simple white ribbed tank top with wide shoulder straps. Her face is turned toward the left side of the frame, and she looks into the distance rather than at the camera. Her expression is serious, quiet, and thoughtful, with relaxed closed lips.  Soft side light enters from the left, illuminating the left side of her face, shoulder, and arms. The opposite side falls into deep shadow. The background is a plain medium-gray wall. The dark furniture fills the lower part of the frame and becomes softly blurred in the foreground.  The photograph has visible fine grain, soft tonal transitions, low contrast in the background, and deeper black tones around the body and furniture. The focus is strongest on her face and the upper arm crossing the frame.

presets.title: Emerald Shadow Dream
presets.summary: A close upward gaze emerges from a nearly black green field.
presets.prompt: A very close vertical portrait of a young adult woman against a nearly black dark-green background. Her face fills most of the frame. Her head is tilted slightly backward and toward one side, and she looks upward past the camera with a quiet, dreamy expression.  She has fair warm-toned skin with many visible freckles across her nose, cheeks, forehead, and around the eyes. Her eyes are green-gray, framed by long dark eyelashes and thick natural dark eyebrows. She has long black wavy hair with loose curls and soft uneven bangs falling around her forehead and temples.  Her lips are full and covered with muted warm terracotta lipstick. Her mouth is slightly open, showing a small part of her teeth and metal braces. One hand is placed along the side of her neck and jaw, with the fingers extending upward behind the ear. She wears a black ribbed knit sweater, and the sleeve covers part of her wrist.  Soft low light falls across the center of her face, revealing the freckles, eyes, lips, and natural skin texture. The sides of her hair, clothing, and background merge into deep shadow. The color palette is dark and restrained, with black hair, a green-black background, warm skin, muted orange lips, and green eyes.

presets.title: Silver-Haired Formal
presets.summary: A mature formal portrait with calm confidence and restrained studio light.
presets.prompt: A vertical formal studio portrait of a mature light-skinned man, framed from the middle of the torso upward. His body is positioned almost directly toward the camera, while his head is turned slightly toward the right side of the frame. He looks past the camera with blue-gray eyes and a calm, confident expression. His lips form a very subtle restrained smile.  He has neatly styled salt-and-pepper hair with darker sides and silver-gray strands on top. The hair is combed back and slightly to one side, with smooth volume above the forehead. He has thick dark-gray eyebrows, fine lines across the forehead and around the eyes, a strong jaw, and short gray stubble covering the cheeks, chin, and upper lip.  He wears a black tuxedo jacket with wide satin peak lapels, a white formal shirt, and a black bow tie. A softly folded white pocket square is visible in the breast pocket. White French cuffs extend beyond the jacket sleeves, with round black cufflinks. A round silver wristwatch with a pale face and a dark leather strap is visible on his left wrist.  Both hands are raised vertically in front of his chest and lower face. His palms are gently pressed together, with the fingers pointing upward beside his chin. The hands are relaxed and slightly angled toward the camera.  The background is plain and smooth, changing from medium charcoal gray on the left to nearly black on the right. Soft directional studio light illuminates his forehead, eyes, cheekbones, nose, hands, shirt cuffs, and the silver parts of the watch. The opposite sides of his face and jacket fall into gentle shadow. The black clothing blends softly into the dark background, while the face, hands, and white details remain clearly visible.

presets.title: Split-Color Symmetry
presets.summary: A centered beauty portrait divided by teal shadow and amber light.
presets.prompt: A vertical close portrait of a young adult woman, centered and facing the camera directly. The frame includes her head, long neck, bare shoulders, collarbones, and the upper part of her chest. Her posture is straight and symmetrical. She looks directly into the camera with a calm, serious expression, and her full lips are slightly parted.  She has warm medium skin, green eyes, thick dark eyebrows, long defined eyelashes, and subtle black eyeliner extending slightly beyond the outer corners of the eyes. Her lips have a smooth glossy nude-pink color. Her dark brown hair is pulled tightly back, with a precise middle part and a smooth surface around the head. Both ears are visible.  One bent hand or forearm enters the lower foreground and rests close to the center of her chest. It is softly blurred and covered by warm orange light, while her face remains the main point of focus.  The lighting uses two strongly contrasting colors. Cool teal-green light covers most of the left side of her face, the left side of her neck, and her left shoulder. Intense orange-yellow light illuminates the right side of her forehead, right temple, right cheek, lips, jaw, neck, collarbone, and shoulder. A hard diagonal edge between light and shadow crosses the forehead and face, creating a clear split between the cool and warm areas.  The background is a plain muted yellow-olive wall. A large bright yellow-orange patch of light appears behind the right side of her head and shoulder, with a sharp diagonal border. The left side of the background is darker and more olive. The composition is clean, centered, and strongly symmetrical, with deep shadows around the eyes, nose, jaw, and neck.

presets.title: Hazel Quiet Gaze
presets.summary: Natural features and soft shadow create a vulnerable close portrait.
presets.prompt: A vertical close portrait of a young adult woman facing the camera directly, framed from the upper chest upward. Her head is centered, and her shoulders are relaxed. She looks straight into the camera with warm hazel-brown eyes and a quiet, slightly vulnerable expression. Her full natural lips are gently parted, showing a small part of her upper teeth.  She has warm light skin, thick dark eyebrows, long eyelashes, a straight nose, softly defined cheekbones, and natural peach-pink lips with a slight sheen. Her makeup is restrained, with softly defined eyes and even skin.  Her long dark brown hair has a middle part and falls loosely along both sides of her face. The hair is softly wavy, with several loose strands curving across the cheeks and neck. Most of the hair merges into the dark background. She wears a dark muted teal-green collared shirt with an open neckline. The collar and upper edges of the shirt are visible near the lower part of the frame.  The background is plain and nearly black, with a subtle deep green tone. A hard-edged band of warm golden light crosses the central part of her face. The light illuminates part of her forehead, the area around her right eyebrow and eye, the bridge and tip of her nose, sections of both cheeks, her lips, chin, and a narrow area of her neck. The top of the forehead, the outer sides of the face, and much of the neck remain in deep shadow.  Thin curved shadows from loose strands of hair appear across the left cheek. The warm illuminated skin stands out strongly against the dark hair, dark clothing, and nearly black background. The portrait has strong contrast, sharp borders between light and shadow, and a calm intimate mood.

presets.title: Freckled Close Focus
presets.summary: An extreme close-up celebrates natural skin texture and hazel detail.
presets.prompt: A vertical extreme close-up portrait of a young adult woman. Her face fills almost the entire frame and is turned slightly toward the left side of the image, while her eyes look toward the right side of the frame. The crop includes most of her forehead, both eyes, nose, lips, chin, and part of her neck. Parts of her hair and face extend beyond the edges of the frame.  She has fair warm-toned skin covered with dense red-brown freckles. The freckles are especially concentrated across the forehead, bridge and sides of the nose, upper cheeks, under the eyes, around the mouth, and across the chin. Fine pores and natural skin texture are clearly visible.  Her eyes are green-hazel with warm brown areas around the pupils. The eye on the right side of the frame is sharp and clearly focused, showing individual eyelashes and a bright rectangular reflection in the iris. The eye on the left side of the frame is softer, slightly blurred, and partly surrounded by shadow. She has thick dark natural eyebrows and long separated eyelashes.  Her nose is shown very close to the camera, with freckles covering the bridge and tip. Her full lips have a natural muted peach color and a soft texture. The lips are slightly open, revealing part of her white front teeth. Her expression is relaxed and thoughtful.  Her dark brown to black hair surrounds the face and blends into the nearly black background. Several thin loose strands cross the forehead, cheeks, jaw, and neck. Soft warm light falls across the central and right portions of her face, while the left edge and surrounding hair remain darker. The focus is shallow, keeping the nearest eye, nose, freckles, and lips detailed while the farther eye and background become softer.

presets.title: Reflected Window Gaze
presets.summary: A monochrome face meets soft city reflections through glass.
presets.prompt: A vertical black-and-white portrait photographed through a reflective window. A young adult woman stands very close behind the glass, with her face positioned slightly left of center. She looks directly into the camera with an intense, steady gaze. She has light eyes, long dark eyelashes, strongly defined dark eyebrows, a narrow straight nose, pronounced cheekbones, and full closed lips. Her expression is serious, controlled, and unsmiling.  Her hair and the upper part of her head are mostly hidden behind a large pale reflection on the glass. She wears a plain black high-neck top that blends into the dark lower part of the image. Only her face and a small part of her shoulders remain clearly visible.  The window creates several overlapping reflections. A large soft white and light-gray area fills most of the upper half of the frame and covers her forehead. Faint rectangular shapes resembling distant buildings appear inside this bright reflection. A darker blurred reflection crosses the left side of her face and part of her nose. The glass has subtle streaks and soft changes in brightness.  A dark vertical window frame runs along the right edge of the image, followed by a narrow pale border. The lower part of the portrait is nearly black, while the upper part contains a large amount of bright empty space. Her eyes, nose, and lips are the sharpest parts of the image, while the reflected shapes remain soft and indistinct. The composition feels minimal, quiet, and slightly distant.

presets.title: Apartment Joy
presets.summary: An arm's-length smile fills a bright open apartment.
presets.prompt: A horizontal casual selfie of a young adult woman inside a bright open-plan apartment. She is very close to the camera and centered in the foreground, framed from the upper torso upward. Both of her arms extend toward the camera from the lower corners, creating the feeling that she is holding the camera herself.  She has fair warm-toned skin with a few subtle freckles, green-hazel eyes, natural dark eyebrows, and long wavy medium-brown hair. Her hair is loosely gathered into a small messy top knot on top of her head, while most of it falls over both shoulders in relaxed waves. Several loose strands frame her face.  She looks directly into the camera with a large joyful smile, showing her upper and lower teeth. Her cheeks are raised, and her expression is open, friendly, and spontaneous. She wears a loose light gray or cream knitted sweater with a visible textured pattern and wide sleeves. Her makeup is minimal and natural.  The room behind her is softly blurred. It has white walls and a warm wooden floor. On the left side there is a large dark television on a low wooden stand, along with a tall green houseplant. A wooden dining table and chairs stand farther back near the center, with kitchen objects and small appliances visible behind them.  On the right side there is a brown leather sofa with a pale cushion, a patterned rug, a large round-leaved green plant, and a small round robot vacuum near the wall. An open doorway or storage area is visible in the distance. Soft natural daylight fills the room. The wide perspective makes her face appear close and prominent while the apartment stretches into the background.

presets.title: Bedroom Phone Moment
presets.summary: A playful floor-level phone portrait in a simple sunlit room.
presets.prompt: A horizontal playful indoor portrait of a young adult woman sitting on a wooden floor in a bright simple bedroom. She is positioned slightly left of center and looks toward a smartphone held in front of her.  She has fair skin and short blonde hair cut into a loose chin-length bob. The hair is slightly tousled, with a few strands falling around her forehead and cheeks. She wears small metallic hoop earrings and an oversized faded charcoal-gray sweatshirt with long loose sleeves. A raised knee covered by light gray fabric is visible in the lower left corner.  Her right arm is fully extended toward the camera. She holds a dark gray smartphone very close to the lens, causing the phone and her hand to appear large and softly blurred in the upper-right foreground. The back of the phone is visible, including a square camera area with several dark lenses.  She raises her other hand beside her face and makes a small finger-heart gesture with her thumb and index finger. She smiles broadly, showing her teeth, and closes one eye in a playful wink. Her expression is cheerful, relaxed, and informal.  The room has a pale gray wall on the left, a white door or wardrobe behind her, and white drawers or cabinets on the right. A small wall shelf holds a green potted plant and a light-colored container. A red bag hangs in the background. The edge of a bed appears at the far right. Soft daylight illuminates the room evenly. Her face is the main point of focus, while the phone, hand, and parts of the background are slightly blurred.

presets.title: Window Knit Closeup
presets.summary: Chunky fabric and striped sunlight frame an intimate curled-up pose.
presets.prompt: A vertical close portrait of a young adult woman sitting in a curled-up position near a window. Her face is centered between her raised legs and arms, creating a tight and intimate composition. The camera is close to her and positioned slightly below eye level.  She has warm light-to-medium skin, brown eyes, thick dark eyebrows, and long straight dark brown hair with a clean middle part. Her hair falls smoothly around both sides of her face and continues over her shoulders. Bright sunlight creates a soft shine along the top layers of her hair.  She looks directly into the camera with a calm, slightly pensive expression. Her lips are gently pushed forward in a subtle pout. Her makeup is soft and restrained, with dark eyelashes, lightly defined eyes, and natural brown-pink lips.  She wears an oversized beige chunky knitted sweater with a mixture of cable-knit, ribbed, and raised woven patterns. A large sweater-covered arm fills much of the lower-right foreground. One raised leg in pale blue or light gray trousers fills the left side of the frame. Her face rests close to her knee or sleeve, as though she is hugging her legs against her chest.  Direct warm sunlight enters through window blinds. Thin repeated lines of light and shadow cross the left side of her face, her cheek, nose, lips, sweater, and trousers. The right side of her hair also catches a bright band of sunlight. Other parts of her face and body remain in deeper shadow.  The background is a plain dark charcoal-gray wall with a small corner detail near the top left. The foreground fabric is slightly soft, while her eyes and central facial features remain clear. The image emphasizes the texture of the knitted sweater, the smooth dark hair, and the narrow striped shadows from the blinds.

presets.title: Balcony Night Snapshot
presets.summary: A spontaneous terrace portrait leaves generous space for the dark sky.
presets.prompt: A vertical nighttime snapshot of a young adult woman standing outdoors on a balcony or terrace. She is shown from the head to the hips and positioned in the lower central part of the frame, with a large area of empty black night sky above her.  Her body is turned partly away from the camera, while her face is shown in side profile facing the right side of the image. Her chin is raised slightly, her eyes appear closed or lowered, and her lips are softly pursed. Her pose is calm and still.  She has very long straight dark brown hair falling smoothly down her back and over one shoulder. The hair reaches below her waist and catches a small amount of light from the camera flash. A few shorter strands frame the side of her face.  She wears a fitted cobalt-blue long-sleeve top with a high round neckline. The top follows the shape of her torso and is tucked into light blue high-waisted jeans. A narrow black belt is visible around her waist. A thin metallic chain strap runs from one shoulder diagonally down the side of her body, while the attached bag remains outside the frame. Her arms appear to be held behind her back.  Direct camera flash illuminates her face, hair, blue top, and the upper part of her jeans. The light creates clear highlights on the fabric and leaves the background almost completely black. A white horizontal balcony railing runs behind her at waist level, with dark vertical metal bars farther back. A few tiny distant lights are visible in the darkness.  The image has the appearance of a casual low-light phone photograph, with slightly soft focus, limited background detail, and strong contrast between the brightly lit woman and the black night.

presets.title: Floor Wall Portrait
presets.summary: A relaxed seated pose and plain wall create an honest casual frame.
presets.prompt: A vertical casual indoor portrait of a young adult woman sitting on the floor and leaning back against a pale gray-green wall. Her body is angled slightly toward the left side of the frame, while her face is turned directly toward the camera. She looks into the lens with a calm neutral expression and gently closed lips.  She has warm light skin, dark eyebrows, light gray-green eyes, and long thick dark brown hair. Her hair is loose, slightly wavy, and divided near the center, falling around her face and over both shoulders. Her makeup is soft, with lightly defined eyes, pink blush, and natural muted lips.  She wears a fitted black long-sleeve top with an asymmetric neckline. One shoulder and part of her upper chest are exposed, while a narrow section of black fabric runs around the base of her neck. She also wears loose light blue high-waisted jeans with a faded wash, visible seams, large folds, and a wide shape.  Her legs extend toward the camera and fill much of the lower-left foreground, creating a strong sense of depth. One arm reaches down behind her and supports her body against the floor or wall. Her other arm is mostly hidden behind her raised leg.  The room is simple and softly lit. A white wardrobe or sliding cabinet is visible on the left, along with part of a round standing fan. A dark vertical doorway edge appears behind her head. On the right is a pale wall with several dark green plant leaves entering from the edge. The light is dim and diffused, with muted gray, black, and pale blue colors. The image has soft focus and the natural appearance of a casual phone photograph.

presets.title: Low-Angle Knit Selfie
presets.summary: Hair, hand, and a soft sleeve crowd a quiet low-angle closeup.
presets.prompt: A close square indoor selfie of a young adult woman, photographed from a slightly low angle. Her face, hair, hand, and sleeve fill almost the entire frame. She looks directly into the camera with a quiet, slightly tired expression. Her full lips are gently pushed forward and remain closed.  She has warm light skin, dark brown eyes, thick straight dark eyebrows, long eyelashes, and softly defined eye makeup. Her nose has a gentle highlight, and her lips have a natural muted pink-brown color.  Her long straight hair is dark auburn-brown with warm copper and reddish highlights. It is parted near the center and falls loosely around both sides of her face. A strong warm light catches the hair at the top of her head, creating a brighter reddish area near the part.  She rests the lower part of her face against a thick dark navy-blue sleeve that crosses the entire bottom of the frame. One hand is raised beside her cheek, with the wrist bent and the fingers loosely curved. A dark ribbed cuff surrounds her wrist. A thin pale cable is faintly visible near the right edge beside her hand.  The background is a softly blurred indoor space with warm gray and brown tones. A dark rectangular shape appears behind the left side of her hair. The lighting is warm and uneven, coming mainly from above and slightly in front of her. The image has soft details, slight grain, and the intimate appearance of a casual front-camera selfie.

presets.title: Streetlight Night Portrait
presets.summary: A direct nighttime snapshot balances warm skin against a quiet street.
presets.prompt: A vertical nighttime portrait of a young adult woman standing outdoors on a quiet street or parking area. She is centered in the frame and photographed from approximately the waist upward. Her body faces the camera directly, and her shoulders are relaxed.  She has warm medium skin and very long straight dark brown hair with a clean middle part. Her hair falls evenly along both sides of her face and continues past her chest. The smooth surface of the hair reflects the direct light from the camera.  Her eyes are closed, and she has a large joyful smile showing her teeth. Her cheeks are raised, giving the portrait a spontaneous and cheerful expression. She wears a loose black hoodie with the hood resting behind her head. A very small white word or symbol is visible at the center of the chest.  A direct camera flash brightly illuminates her face, hair, and the front of the hoodie. The background remains dark and slightly green-gray. Behind her on the left is part of a plain building with a dark barred window and dense bushes beneath it. On the right is an empty paved road or parking area.  A bright streetlamp stands behind her near the upper-right part of the frame, creating a glowing white circle. Thin bare tree branches are visible around the lamp, while the rest of the sky is nearly black. The background is softly blurred and underexposed. The image has noticeable low-light grain, slightly soft focus, and the simple appearance of a casual nighttime phone photograph.

presets.title: Retro Restroom Mirror
presets.summary: A tilted mirror pose catches dim patterned light and vintage atmosphere.
presets.prompt: A vertical mirror selfie of a young adult woman inside a dim retro restroom or changing area. She is positioned in the lower-left half of the frame and is shown from the upper torso upward. Her head is tilted strongly toward one shoulder, and her chin is raised slightly. She looks toward the upper-left side of the mirror instead of directly at the phone, with a calm and slightly playful expression.  She has warm medium skin, dark eyes, softly defined eyebrows, long eyelashes, and natural muted lips. Her long straight dark brown hair falls smoothly over one shoulder and continues below the bottom edge of the frame.  She wears a black off-the-shoulder top with a low straight neckline. Her shoulders, collarbones, and upper chest are exposed. One long loose black sleeve covers the arm holding the phone and gathers slightly around the wrist.  She holds a black smartphone vertically in front of her chest. The phone case is decorated with several bright red cherries and small green stems. Her fingers are spread across the back of the phone, showing long pointed white nails.  The room has olive-green painted walls, doors, and vertical panels. On the right side are narrow pink stall doors or cabinets with dark metal handles, surrounded by teal and green surfaces. A large mirror fills most of the composition.  In the upper part of the mirror, several round white hanging lamps are reflected. The ceiling or rear wall is covered with a dense collage of many small dark photographs and images. The lighting is warm and dim, with olive, black, pink, and teal colors. The photograph has visible grain and the slightly faded appearance of a casual phone mirror selfie.

presets.title: Rooftop Wide-Angle Selfie
presets.summary: An exaggerated high viewpoint bends a dense city around the subject.
presets.prompt: A vertical extreme wide-angle selfie taken from very high above a dense city. The camera is attached to the end of a long selfie stick and looks steeply downward. The strong curved perspective makes the buildings and streets spread outward around the edges of the image.  A young adult woman stands on a very small round gray metal platform at the top of a tall tower spire. She is positioned slightly left of center and looks upward toward the camera with a broad smile. She wears round pink mirrored sunglasses.  She has light skin and long light brown hair swept over one shoulder and moved slightly by the wind. She wears a sleeveless dark burgundy dress or long top that reaches above the knees, along with white athletic shoes and short pale socks with small colored details.  One arm is fully extended outward, holding the long black selfie stick. Her other hand holds a small black smartphone or electronic device near her waist. The circular platform has no visible railing. A small square metal plate with several bolts is attached near her feet.  Directly beneath the platform is a narrow golden tower shaft. Farther below, the roof of the skyscraper forms a large geometric shape filled with intense golden lights. The warm light from the building contrasts with the cool gray city around it.  The city extends far below in every direction, with dense blocks of buildings, narrow streets, moving cars, intersections, and several tall towers. A river curves through the upper-left background, crossed by bridges. A large formal building complex with wide open areas stands on the opposite bank. On the right are two especially tall skyscrapers, including one under construction with cranes at the top.  The distant city is covered by thick pale gray haze, causing the horizon and far buildings to disappear gradually. The composition emphasizes the tiny circular platform, the woman above the glowing tower, and the enormous foggy city far beneath her.

presets.title: Freefall Camera Smile
presets.summary: An action camera catches a bearded skydiver grinning above the coast.
presets.prompt: A wide horizontal action-camera selfie of an adult man skydiving in freefall high above the ground. His face is very close to the camera in the center of the frame. He has a thick reddish-brown beard and a wide excited smile with his teeth visible. He is wearing a smooth black skydiving helmet with a small rectangular camera mounted on top, large black wraparound goggles, a black T-shirt with a white graphic on the chest, and a black parachute harness and backpack.  His right arm is stretched toward the camera and fills the lower-right side of the frame, appearing much larger because it is close to the lens. His left arm is extended outward toward the left edge. His body is horizontal, facing the ground, with both legs bent upward behind him and dark shoes visible in the upper-right background.  Far below him is a dark green landscape with fields, thin roads, small areas of water, and scattered white clouds at different heights. The camera is pointing downward, so there is no visible horizon. Bright daylight falls directly on his face and arms, creating warm skin tones and dark shadows under the helmet and goggles. Close wide-angle perspective, energetic facial expression, slightly soft action-camera image.

presets.title: Airplane Exit Rush
presets.summary: Wind, aircraft, and open sky compress the instant after a jump.
presets.prompt: A tall vertical action photo of an adult man skydiving directly below a small white airplane. The man is close to the camera and centered in the upper half of the frame. He has medium-length brown hair flying upward in the wind, a short brown beard, reflective blue sunglasses, and an open mouth with an excited shouting expression. He is wearing a fitted black T-shirt, tan cargo pants, black gloves, dark shoes, and a black parachute backpack with a secure harness, metal buckles, and straps across his chest and waist.  His body is horizontal in freefall with his chest facing the camera. Both arms are stretched wide to the sides. His knees are bent and his feet point upward behind him. His left glove is visible near the left edge, while his right hand is partly cropped near the right edge.  The underside of a weathered white propeller airplane fills the top of the frame. The aircraft has an open rectangular side door with a dark interior, visible rivets and panels, a large wing crossing above the man, and two landing wheels hanging below the fuselage.  Far below is a long curved coastline. Deep blue ocean fills the right side, with bright turquoise shallow water near the shore. Sandy beaches, green hills, roads, buildings, and small towns stretch along the left side of the coast. Large white clouds float between the camera and the ground. Bright blue sky, direct daytime sunlight, clear separation between the skydiver, airplane, coastline, and ocean. Wide-angle view with a strong feeling of height and distance.

presets.title: Tilted Sky Dive
presets.summary: A sharply rotated horizon turns freefall into a dynamic graphic composition.
presets.prompt: A wide horizontal action photo with the entire composition strongly tilted sideways. The horizon and the large cloud layer run almost vertically along the left side of the frame. A small white propeller airplane is positioned diagonally in the upper-right area, seen from below. The aircraft has red stripes, a black lower fuselage, large white registration lettering along the black section, visible landing wheels, a wing extending across the top, and a propeller near the upper edge.  A bald adult man has just jumped from the airplane and is falling away beneath it. His body is placed near the right-center of the frame. He is wearing a light gray long-sleeve shirt, a dark vest or parachute harness, dark trousers, black gloves, and light-colored shoes. His arms are spread wide, one leg is extended downward, and the other leg is slightly bent. His head is turned toward the airplane.  A thick white cloud layer covers most of the left side and stretches far into the distance. A narrow area of deep blue sky separates the clouds from the airplane. Bright daylight, unusual sideways camera angle, wide view, slightly soft action-camera detail.

presets.title: Three Canopies Below
presets.summary: A broad aerial view follows parachutists drifting over green country.
presets.prompt: A wide horizontal aerial photo of three parachutists descending high above a broad green landscape. The main parachutist is near the center-right of the frame beneath a large rectangular parachute canopy. The canopy fills much of the upper-right area and is divided into bright red, orange, and white fabric sections. Many thin suspension lines connect the canopy to the person below. The parachutist is wearing dark clothing, holding both arms upward near the control lines, with both legs hanging freely.  A second parachutist is far away in the upper-left background beneath a much smaller red, black, and white rectangular canopy. A third parachutist is near the far-right edge beneath a small dark blue canopy, partly cropped by the frame.  The ground below contains large green fields, darker forest areas, small towns, roads, several lakes, and winding bodies of water. The land becomes hazy toward the distant horizon. The upper part of the frame contains a bright blue sky with long thin white clouds. The camera is slightly tilted, making the horizon slope gently. The large orange parachute is the main focus, while the two distant parachutists show the scale and height of the scene.

presets.title: Sunset Mountain Jump
presets.summary: Two friends hold hands in midair above a dark mountain viewpoint.
presets.prompt: A tall vertical outdoor photo of a young adult man and woman jumping together on a dark mountain viewpoint during sunset. They are positioned in the lower-middle part of the frame, with a very large open sky above them. Both people are completely airborne and holding hands between them.  The man is on the left. He has short dark hair and is looking downward. He is wearing a dark blue denim jacket over a light beige T-shirt, fitted black pants, and tan sneakers with light soles. His left arm is bent downward with a closed fist. His right arm is raised to hold the woman’s left hand. One of his knees is bent downward, while his other leg is kicked high toward the camera, showing the bottom of his shoe.  The woman is on the right. She has long dark hair moving slightly in the air and a wide happy smile directed toward the camera. She is wearing a white sleeveless blouse tied at the front, blue-gray fitted pants, and white sneakers. Her left hand holds the man’s hand, while her right arm is stretched straight upward. One knee is lifted and bent, while her other leg extends downward.  Behind them is a wide mountain valley with dark forested hills, distant mountain silhouettes, and a winding river or lake divided into many curved channels and small islands. The foreground ridge is dark and runs along the bottom edge. The sky changes from pale blue at the top to soft warm pink and cream near the horizon. Warm low sunlight touches the edges of their faces, arms, clothing, and shoes, while the landscape below remains dark and cool.

presets.title: Pier Toss
presets.summary: A laughing group freezes the instant a friend leaves the dock.
presets.prompt: A wide horizontal candid moment on a wooden pier beside a calm lake at sunset. A large group of formally dressed adults is crowded on the left half of the pier, leaning forward and laughing as they throw a bearded man off the edge.  The man is frozen in midair on the right side, almost upside down, with his torso close to the water, his knees bent toward his chest, and both legs raised. One black shoe points upward. He wears a white dress shirt, a dark vest, dark trousers, and black shoes. He smiles toward the camera and stretches one arm down toward the lake.  A tall man at the edge of the pier wears a white shirt with rolled sleeves and black trousers. He holds the falling man by the legs, while several people behind him reach forward to help. The group includes men in white shirts and gray-green vests and women in light dresses and long coats. At the far left, a woman in a pale floral dress is partly cropped by the frame and holds a small child wrapped in light-colored clothing.  The wooden planks begin in the lower foreground and lead diagonally toward the group. Warm sunlight shines across the boards and creates long dark shadows. The lake is smooth and reflects the falling man, the sky, and the distant shoreline. A low line of trees stretches across the horizon. The sky is covered with soft gray clouds and warm orange light near the horizon. Golden backlight, spontaneous movement, joyful expressions, slightly soft and grainy photograph.

presets.title: Canyon Slackline
presets.summary: A tiny silhouette balances across a vast opening between dark cliffs.
presets.prompt: A wide horizontal silhouette scene of a lone person balancing on a slackline stretched across a deep rocky gap. Huge irregular rock cliffs rise from the lower-left and lower-right corners. The cliffs are almost completely black, with no visible surface details, leaving a large open space in the center.  Two thin lines run from the left cliff to the right cliff with a slight downward angle. The person stands near the center on the lower line, seen in profile. One knee is slightly bent, and both arms are raised and bent for balance.  Directly behind the person is a bright white solar eclipse shaped like an almost complete glowing ring, with a small open gap near the lower-right side. The human silhouette appears inside the luminous circle. A soft pale halo surrounds the eclipse.  The sky is filled with dark haze and muted shades of brown, burnt orange, dark red, and gray. The lower half of the image is dominated by the black rock silhouettes. The person is very small compared with the glowing eclipse and the cliffs. Distant viewpoint, centered composition, strong contrast, quiet and minimal scene.

presets.title: Volcano Swing
presets.summary: A quiet wooden swing faces the raw spectacle of an erupting volcano.
presets.prompt: A wide horizontal outdoor photo of a man riding a simple wooden swing while facing an erupting volcano. The man is positioned in the lower-left part of the frame, seen from behind and slightly from the side. He sits on a narrow wooden seat, holds two long ropes with both hands, leans slightly backward, and extends his bent legs forward.  He wears a dark navy short-sleeve T-shirt, light gray knee-length shorts, dark ankle socks, and black athletic shoes. The two swing ropes rise diagonally toward the upper-left corner and disappear beside a tree and a small wooden structure. Leafy branches frame the upper-left edge, while green grass, shrubs, and a small tree fill the lower-left foreground.  A large dark volcanic mountain fills the lower background. Its slopes are partly hidden by pale clouds and mist. From the summit, an enormous dense gray ash plume rises high into the sky. The plume is made of many large rounded clouds, forming a tall column before spreading sideways across the upper-left and central part of the frame. Smaller ash clouds extend horizontally above the mountain.  The right half of the image contains a clear blue sky. Bright sunlight enters from the far right, creating a white glowing area, soft haze, and a faint circular lens flare. The man appears very small compared with the mountain and the giant ash cloud.

presets.title: Jungle Waterfall Pause
presets.summary: A lone figure pauses on wet rock inside dense tropical green.
presets.prompt: A tall vertical view inside a dense tropical jungle. A shirtless adult man stands with his back to the camera on a wet dark rocky ledge in the lower center of the frame. He has short dark hair, a lean muscular back, a small vertical mark or tattoo between his shoulder blades, beige knee-length shorts, and bare feet.  Both of his arms are stretched wide at shoulder height, with his palms open. He faces an enormous wall of waterfalls and thick green vegetation.  A powerful broad white waterfall drops vertically from a high cliff on the left side. Several thinner streams of water descend from the top and upper-right side, creating long white curtains against the dark rock. On the lower right, water flows over uneven black stone ledges and separates into many smaller cascades.  The cliff walls are covered with dense vines, moss, and small green leaves. Mist and water spray fill the lower-middle area and soften the background. Large glossy tropical leaves, ferns, and wet plants cover the foreground along the bottom and lower-right corner. Dense jungle trees frame the upper-left area. Dark green and charcoal tones, dim natural light passing through the forest canopy, wet surfaces, deep shadows, strong vertical scale.

presets.title: Sunset Barrel Ride
presets.summary: A surfer crouches inside a glowing turquoise wave at dusk.
presets.prompt: A tall vertical surf photo during a warm sunset. A large turquoise ocean wave rises from the right and curls over toward the left, forming a hollow barrel across the middle of the frame.  A male surfer is positioned slightly left of center inside the barrel. He crouches very low on a white surfboard, with both knees deeply bent, his torso leaning forward, and his arms extended for balance. His upper body and dark board shorts are mostly in shadow. He looks toward the open part of the wave.  The face of the wave is dark blue-green with visible curved lines and smooth flowing texture. The upper lip is translucent turquoise and folds over the surfer. Thick white foam explodes on the left side. Fine water spray rises above the wave and blows backward, glowing in the warm sunlight.  The lower third of the frame is filled with rippled dark blue-gray ocean water. In the upper-left background, a tall dark coastal cliff rises above the sea and is covered with trees. Several small pavilion-like buildings with pointed, layered roofs appear as silhouettes along the top of the cliff. At the base of the cliff, a narrow shoreline or viewing platform is crowded with many tiny people and several vertical flags.  The open sea horizon extends across the right side. The sky is pale peach and golden, with soft horizontal clouds. Warm sunlight illuminates the mist and spray, while the wave remains cool blue and green.

presets.title: Ocean Cliff Leap
presets.summary: A small airborne figure marks the scale of a dark coastal cliff.
presets.prompt: A tall vertical sunset photo of a cliff jump above the ocean. A massive dark rocky cliff fills the entire left side of the frame, rising straight up from the water. The ocean stretches across the lower-right half of the image with small ripples and a dark blue surface. A soft splash is visible near the base of the cliff.  At the top edge of the cliff, three people appear as dark silhouettes against the bright sky. One person stands still near the far left, wearing a cap and a backpack, watching the action. Near the cliff edge, two other people are in motion. One person is just pushing off from the cliff with bent legs, leaning forward. The other person is already fully in the air, slightly higher and farther to the right, with one arm raised, knees bent, and hair flying back. Their bodies are close together and they appear connected by one hand, creating a dynamic midair moment.  The horizon line runs across the middle-lower part of the frame. The sky is filled with warm pale orange and peach tones, fading into soft gray-blue clouds. The people and the cliff are almost completely black in silhouette, while the sky remains bright and gentle. Strong contrast, distant viewpoint, dramatic timing, quiet ocean, and a spontaneous adventurous mood.

presets.title: Reflected Beach Kiss
