Soft directional light creates short, defined shadows beneath the tubes and emphasizes the layered paper edges. Modern, playful, color-block cosmetics campaign.

presets.title: Grapefruit Hand Cream
presets.summary: A crumpled cream tube rests among grapefruit, herbs, and parchment.
presets.prompt: A top-down botanical skincare flat lay on wrinkled beige parchment paper. A squeezed metal tube of hand cream lies vertically in the center, with a small black cap at the top and a dense black printed label covering most of the tube. Around it are pieces of fresh pink grapefruit, including a large half grapefruit near the upper-right corner and another partial slice entering from the lower-left edge. Thin rosemary sprigs, dry beige leaves, bright magenta flower petals, and scattered white powder are spread naturally across the paper. The edge of a small white ceramic cup filled with pale yellow liquid appears in the lower-right corner. The parchment has visible creases and uneven handmade texture. Warm natural window light falls from the upper left, producing soft shadows and highlighting the fruit, herbs, powder, and crumpled packaging. Organic, imperfect, quiet botanical beauty campaign.

presets.title: Blush Beauty Still Life
presets.summary: Cosmetics balance on limestone beneath sculpted dusty-pink paper.
presets.prompt: An editorial cosmetics still life in soft blush pink, beige, and warm neutral tones. A large sheet of dusty pink paper is folded into sculptural waves and pinned at the top against a raw light-gray wall, continuing downward across the tabletop. Two rough rectangular limestone blocks are stacked in the center as display platforms. Arranged on and around the stones are a tall frosted white skincare bottle with a silver cap, a round white cosmetic compact, a small pale-lilac nail polish bottle, an open black powder compact, a slim red lipstick, and a round amber perfume bottle with a glossy black domed cap. A pale green facial roller, small gold earrings, and a delicate bracelet rest on the pink surface in front. The arrangement is asymmetrical but carefully balanced. Soft side lighting creates gentle shadows across the folded paper and rough stone textures, giving the scene a calm, artistic beauty-editorial mood.

presets.title: Complete Studio Kit
presets.summary: Cameras, lenses, lights, stands, and storage form an orderly flat lay.
presets.prompt: A top-down flat lay of a complete professional photography studio kit arranged across a warm cream-colored paper background. A rolled beige seamless backdrop runs diagonally near the top of the frame. Two folded black tripods stretch along the upper edge, with additional collapsed light stands positioned along the left side. A large octagonal softbox is partially visible in the upper-left corner. In the center are two black professional camera bodies, several black camera lenses arranged in a row, a compact flash unit, and multiple wireless radio triggers with antennas. On the right side are a closed silver laptop, several black and orange external hard drives, and a small additional lens. On the left are two rectangular studio power packs with switches, dials, sockets, and handles, beside a stack of round black honeycomb grids. Across the lower half are several large gray studio flash heads with silver reflectors and neatly coiled black power cables. A long black fabric equipment bag lies near the bottom edge. Dense but organized arrangement, accurate equipment proportions, soft even overhead lighting, subtle natural shadows.

presets.title: Dual Mesh Watches
presets.summary: Gold and silver watches overlap on a restrained black reflection.
presets.prompt: A wide luxury product photograph of two minimalist wristwatches arranged on the right side of a glossy black reflective surface. The front watch has a polished gold case, a matte black dial, thin gold Roman numerals, delicate gold hands, and a black woven metal mesh strap. Behind it is a slightly larger watch with a polished silver case, a charcoal-black dial, fine silver Roman numerals, slim silver hands, and a matching black metal mesh strap. The watches overlap and lean against each other, with the straps forming soft curved shapes around them. Their reflections are visible on the dark surface below. The background is a smooth black-to-charcoal gradient with a large area of empty negative space across the left side. Soft directional light from the upper right creates narrow highlights along the metal cases and reveals the woven texture of the straps, while the rest of the scene remains dark and understated.

presets.title: Armchair Studio Shoot
presets.summary: A photographer frames one beige chair inside an airy daylight studio.
presets.prompt: A wide behind-the-scenes view inside a bright daylight photography studio. A male photographer is seen from behind in the foreground, crouching on one knee and holding a professional camera to his face. He wears a dark green long-sleeve shirt, faded gray denim shorts, and light gray shoes. In the center of the studio stands a small warm beige upholstered armchair with a rounded backrest, three subtle buttons, short curved armrests, and four black tapered legs. The chair is placed on a white seamless paper backdrop that curves upward behind it. A large rectangular softbox and a second octagonal diffuser stand on the left, while a large black beauty dish, a studio flash, and a smaller spotlight with barn doors stand on the right. Floor-to-ceiling windows fill the room with soft natural light. A leafy indoor plant and part of a white sofa are visible on the far left, with an extra tripod and minimal shelving on the far right. Clean pale wooden floor, airy white interior, balanced working-studio composition.

presets.title: Midair Cosmetics Ensemble
presets.summary: A second fixed-seed makeup study balances vivid color in dark space.
presets.prompt: A vertical cosmetics campaign showing a collection of makeup products arranged as though they are suspended in midair against a smooth charcoal-black background. A warm beige liquid foundation bottle with a tall matte black cap is tilted slightly on the lower left. Near the upper center is an open deep red lipstick in a gold inner tube and black rectangular casing, angled upward. A slim black eyeliner pencil crosses behind the lipstick near the top, with a small blue tip visible at one end. Beside the lipstick float a round matte black cosmetic pot and a clear glass gel eyeliner jar with a glossy black product surface. In the lower-right area, an open glossy black blush compact reveals a coral-pink powder pan. A sharpened fuchsia lip pencil runs diagonally across the bottom of the composition. The objects overlap visually without touching, forming a dynamic diagonal cascade from upper left to lower right. Controlled highlights reveal the metal, glass, matte plastic, and glossy surfaces. A narrow reflective black surface at the bottom creates a faint mirror reflection. Minimal white uppercase branding on the black packaging, dramatic yet clean studio lighting.

presets.title: Heritage Textile Line
presets.summary: Historic looms and rollers recede through an old working mill.
presets.prompt: Inside an old textile mill, viewed from a low central position directly along a long weaving production line. Multiple rows of mechanical looms, rollers, shafts, guide bars and worn metal frames extend toward a distant vanishing point. Bright threads and partially woven fabric move across the machines in blocks of mustard yellow, turquoise blue, magenta, orange, cream and black. Large rolls of yarn and fabric are mounted on both sides, including turquoise spools on the left and red, beige and yellow rolls on the right. The machinery has dark teal painted frames, exposed gears, cables and slightly aged surfaces. Soft daylight enters through tall factory windows and roof openings, mixing with warm industrial light. The nearest colorful threads dominate the foreground while the distant machines gradually fall out of focus. Wide horizontal composition, strong depth, no people.

presets.title: Color Grid Factory
presets.summary: A high factory overview turns organized production into a color grid.
presets.prompt: A large, clean manufacturing hall seen from an elevated corner viewpoint, showing the entire production floor from above. Long rows of green, orange, yellow and white industrial machines are arranged in clearly separated work zones. Injection molding equipment, processing stations, control panels, storage bins, worktables and enclosed machine cells fill the spacious interior. A complex network of silver pipes, ventilation ducts, cable trays and utility lines runs along both sides and above the machinery. The polished white floor is marked with straight blue safety lines and organized walking paths. High white structural beams support a corrugated metal ceiling with skylights and evenly spaced round hanging lamps. A yellow overhead bridge crane crosses the far end of the building. Bright natural daylight and cool factory lighting create an orderly, technical atmosphere. Wide-angle composition, no workers in the foreground.

presets.title: Steel Wool Arc
presets.summary: A crouched worker draws a blazing circular arc through the night.
presets.prompt: A dramatic long-exposure scene of a person spinning burning steel wool at night. The person is positioned slightly right of center in a deep crouching stance, one leg bent forward and the other stretched behind, with both arms raised close to the face while controlling the spinning object. Their body appears mostly as a dark silhouette, with subtle blue fabric visible on the trousers. Thousands of glowing orange sparks explode outward in sweeping curved lines, filling nearly the entire frame. A large circular ring of fire is partly visible along the left edge, while dense trails of sparks travel horizontally and diagonally across the black background. Smaller sparks bounce and scatter across the ground, creating a bright glowing line near the bottom. The contrast between the dark figure and the intense orange light creates a powerful sense of motion, heat and controlled industrial energy.

presets.title: Blue Hour Refinery
presets.summary: Dense refinery towers rise in a precise blue-hour industrial study.
presets.prompt: A vast petrochemical refinery photographed from ground level during blue hour. The complex contains many tall cylindrical processing towers, distillation columns, chimneys, ladders, platforms and dense steel frameworks. Large silver pipelines curve through the foreground and connect the different sections of the plant. A massive central processing structure rises above the surrounding equipment, covered with horizontal pipes, catwalks, railings and structural beams. Warm amber work lights glow throughout the refinery, highlighting platforms, pipe joints and machinery against a deep turquoise evening sky. The paved foreground is wide and empty, creating a clear view of the entire facility. Smaller towers and industrial structures continue into the distance on both sides. Wide panoramic composition with balanced spacing between the tallest columns, no people, no vehicles, no visible logos.

presets.title: Solar Panel Automation
presets.summary: White robotic arms coordinate a clean photovoltaic production floor.
presets.prompt: A modern automated solar panel manufacturing facility filled with white industrial robotic arms and interconnected conveyor systems. The view is taken from an elevated position, looking across several parallel production lines. Large articulated robots reach over blue photovoltaic cells and rectangular panel sections moving through metal-framed assembly stations. White and light gray processing machines are enclosed behind transparent safety panels and wire mesh fencing, with yellow access doors and safety markings placed throughout the factory. Roller conveyors, alignment rails, inspection stations, control cabinets and small signal lights create a dense, organized mechanical layout. The entire interior has a clean white, silver and cool blue color palette. Soft daylight enters through high factory windows and combines with even overhead lighting. Repeating robotic arms and production modules create strong visual depth. No workers, no clutter, no text or brand markings.

presets.title: Machine-Side Technician
presets.summary: A kneeling technician makes a careful adjustment beside heavy equipment.
presets.prompt: A young factory technician kneeling beside an industrial machine, carefully adjusting a control box or panel mounted on the side of the equipment. He is wearing a yellow hard hat, a dark blue t-shirt, gray work pants, and a black wristwatch. Blue pneumatic tubes and cables run along the machine, with metal frames, valves, and industrial components surrounding him on both sides. The technician is shown in side profile, focused and concentrated on his task, with one hand holding the panel and the other working near the controls. The factory background is softly blurred, with bright neutral lighting and a clean, modern industrial environment. Medium shot, documentary style, realistic factory atmosphere.

presets.title: Robotic Assembly Cell
presets.summary: Orange industrial robots converge around a central metal fixture.
presets.prompt: An automated manufacturing cell inside a bright industrial plant, featuring several large orange robotic arms arranged around a central metal assembly fixture. The robots are mounted on white bases and positioned at different angles, as if performing synchronized operations on a metal component in the middle. Yellow safety frames, rails, and support structures surround the workstation. The floor is clean and light-colored, with metal tracks, platforms, and technical equipment visible throughout the scene. The background shows more factory machinery, vertical columns, and additional automated stations extending into the distance. Wide-angle view, high-tech industrial setting, strong sense of organized automation, no people, no visible text or watermarks.

presets.title: Factory Engineer
presets.summary: An engineer operates a robotic machining station on the plant floor.
presets.prompt: A factory engineer operating a robotic machining system while standing beside a large industrial machine. He is wearing a yellow hard hat, transparent safety glasses, red hearing protection earmuffs, and a dark blue work coverall. He is holding and using an open laptop connected to the system, looking at the screen while monitoring the machine. Inside the machine enclosure, a large white robotic arm is positioned over a fast-moving work surface or conveyor. The background includes gray machine panels, built-in control screens, buttons, and a modern industrial workstation. Clean, controlled lighting, professional manufacturing environment, side view composition, realistic and technical mood.

presets.title: Precision Gear Machining
presets.summary: A polished gear meets a fine tool inside a modern CNC enclosure.
presets.prompt: A close-up view of a precision CNC machining process inside a modern metalworking machine. On the left side, a cutting or measuring tool extends toward a large polished metal gear or turbine-like component mounted on a spindle. The main part has a circular top section with fine grooves and a series of angled teeth or blades below it. The metal surfaces are highly reflective, smooth, and engineered with extreme precision. Flexible coolant nozzles and machine components are visible near the tool head. The background is softly blurred in cool gray and silver tones, emphasizing the clean, advanced industrial setting. Tight macro composition, sharp focus on the tool and machined part.

presets.title: CNC Cutting Detail
presets.summary: A milling spindle shapes reflective metal in a dramatic close view.
presets.prompt: A dramatic close-up of a CNC milling machine cutting a sculpted metal component. A vertical spindle with a fine cutting tool descends toward a shiny metal workpiece clamped on a dark rectangular fixture block. Bright metal shavings and small sparks appear where the tool meets the material, highlighting the precision cutting action. The machined part has curved, fan-like blades or channels, with smooth polished surfaces catching the light. The machine interior is dark and clean, with warm industrial lighting creating a cinematic contrast between the glowing highlights and the deep shadows. Shallow depth of field, focus on the cutting area, premium precision manufacturing mood.

presets.title: Black Gallardo Estate
presets.summary: A glossy black supercar anchors an ornate mansion driveway at dusk.
presets.prompt: A glossy black Lamborghini Gallardo parked on a wide brick driveway in front of an ornate Mediterranean Revival mansion at dusk. Show the car from a low front three-quarter angle, facing toward the right side of the frame, with its long wedge-shaped body, dark tinted windows, fixed rear wing, black multi-spoke wheels, orange brake calipers, sharp headlights and deep front air intakes clearly visible. The polished black body reflects the surrounding trees and warm exterior lights. Behind the car stands a grand pale-stone residence with an arched entrance, carved columns, decorative stonework, wrought-iron doors and balconies, tall windows glowing with warm amber light, and antique wall lanterns around the entrance. Surround the mansion with manicured hedges, round topiary shrubs, tall cypress trees and large mature trees. Use a wide horizontal composition, with the mansion filling the left background and the car dominating the lower-right foreground. The cool evening shadows contrast with the warm lights from the house. No people.

presets.title: Mountain Valley Peugeot
presets.summary: A white crossover sits in clean profile within a vast remote valley.
presets.prompt: A white first-generation Peugeot 3008 shown in a clean full side profile on a narrow gravel road crossing a remote mountain valley. Place the car near the center of a very wide composition, facing left, with white bodywork, black lower trim, silver wheels, dark windows and red rear lights clearly visible. Keep the vehicle relatively small in the frame so that the landscape feels vast and isolated. The road runs horizontally across the image, bordered by dark green grass, scattered grey stones and uneven rocky ground in the foreground. Behind the car rises a broad mountain slope covered with sparse bushes, leafless trees and patches of muted orange autumn foliage. The weather is cold and overcast, with soft diffused light, deep blue-grey shadows and subdued natural colors. The car should remain the brightest element against the dark landscape. No buildings, road signs, traffic or people.

presets.title: Olive Convertible Villa
presets.summary: An olive grand tourer meets calm modern countryside architecture.
presets.prompt: A metallic olive-green Aston Martin convertible parked outside a low modern countryside villa on a clear sunny afternoon. Show the car from a front three-quarter angle, facing toward the right, with the roof open, pale cream seats, a long sculpted hood, wide horizontal front grille, narrow headlights, muscular rear haunches and large black multi-spoke wheels. The green paint catches the sunlight and reflects the blue sky and surrounding vegetation. Behind the car is a contemporary single-story house with flat projecting roofs, dark horizontal wood cladding, slim black support columns and large floor-to-ceiling glass windows reflecting the landscape and the car. Include a tall palm tree and rows of small olive trees on dry grassy terrain to the left. Frame the lower foreground with large out-of-focus green leaves passing close to the camera, partially covering the driveway and creating a soft natural foreground layer. Strong afternoon sunlight creates defined shadows beneath the roof and car, while the glass facade remains cool and reflective. No people.

presets.title: Alpine 911 Overlook
presets.summary: A silver sports car overlooks a mountain valley in golden light.
presets.prompt: A silver Porsche 911 parked on a rough dirt turnout high above a vast mountain valley during golden hour. Show the car from a rear three-quarter angle, positioned in the lower-left third of the frame and facing toward the distant landscape on the right. Include the curved rear body, dark panoramic rear window, continuous red taillight strip, black wheels, wide tires and twin exhaust outlets. The car stands among tall dry golden grass and small stones on an uneven mountain track. Beyond it, rolling sunlit hills descend into a wide valley, followed by several layers of distant mountain ridges fading into warm atmospheric haze. The low sun enters from the upper-left side, filling the scene with pale golden light and creating long soft shadows across the grass. Give most of the composition to the open landscape and sky, making the car feel like a quiet stop during a solitary mountain journey. No roads, buildings, guardrails or people.

presets.title: Rain Street M8
presets.summary: Bright orange bodywork reflects a wet late-autumn neighborhood.
presets.prompt: A bright orange BMW M8 coupe parked on a rain-soaked residential street during late autumn. Show the car from a very low front three-quarter angle, facing toward the right side of the frame, with the front bumper and wide black kidney grille close to the camera. Give the car a lowered stance, widened wheel arches, sculpted hood, sharp LED headlights, large black air intakes, black side mirrors, dark tinted windows and black multi-spoke wheels. The glossy orange paint reflects the branches of the surrounding trees across the hood, windshield and roof. Cover the wet asphalt with shallow puddles and scattered brown leaves, creating broken reflections beneath the car. Tall dark tree trunks line both sides of the street, while dense orange autumn foliage fills the softly blurred background. Include part of an older pale residential building behind the trees on the right. Use subdued overcast daylight, deep shadows and warm orange foliage against cool grey pavement. No people or other vehicles.

presets.title: Reservoir Electric Drive
presets.summary: A metallic crossover follows turquoise water through open mountains.
presets.prompt: A metallic grey electric crossover driving along a smooth two-lane road beside a long turquoise mountain reservoir on a clear sunny day. View the scene from an elevated front three-quarter angle, looking diagonally across the road as the car travels toward the camera. Place the vehicle slightly below the center of the frame, with its streamlined body, smooth closed front, narrow headlights, dark panoramic roof, tinted windows and silver wheels clearly visible. The road begins in the lower-right foreground and curves gently toward the distant left side of the valley. Create strong directional motion blur in the rocks, dry grass and bushes close to the camera, while keeping the car and distant landscape clear. The calm blue water runs parallel to the road on the right, bordered by a narrow sandy shore. Surround the valley with broad mountain ranges fading into pale blue atmospheric haze. Give most of the upper composition to an open blue sky with a few small white clouds. No traffic, buildings or people.

presets.title: Burnt Orange Waterfront
presets.summary: A modified supercar glows against wet pavement and city reflections.
presets.prompt: A modified metallic burnt-orange Lamborghini Huracán parked diagonally across a wet city street beside a waterfront at night. Show the car from a low front three-quarter angle, with its nose pointing toward the right side of the frame. Give it a very low stance, wide bodywork, sharp hood lines, narrow dark headlights, large black front intakes, an extended carbon front splitter, angular side skirts, black roof, heavily tinted windows, custom black and silver wheels and a large rear wing. The wet pavement and nearby pedestrian crossing reflect orange, cyan, blue and magenta light. Behind the stationary car, create long horizontal white, red and electric-blue light trails from passing traffic, stretching across the road and along the waterfront railing. In the background, show softly blurred historic buildings, palm trees, warm street lamps, distant city lights and dark water. Above the city is a deep blue-black sky with faint stars. No visible driver or pedestrians.

presets.title: Raptor Forest Trail
presets.summary: A red performance pickup waits among dense autumn leaves.
presets.prompt: A red Ford F-150 Raptor parked on a narrow leaf-covered trail deep inside an autumn forest. Show the pickup from a low front three-quarter angle, facing slightly toward the left, with its broad black grille, rectangular LED running lights, raised suspension, black wheel arches, rugged front bumper, large off-road tires, crew cab and short cargo bed clearly visible. Position the truck near the center of the forest path, surrounded by tall straight tree trunks and dense undergrowth. Cover the ground completely with dry orange and brown leaves, with the path gently curving through the woods behind the vehicle. Fill the tree canopy with rich amber, copper and dark orange foliage, while keeping the deepest areas of the forest in heavy shadow. Frame the scene with softly blurred leaves and branches close to the camera on both sides, creating the feeling of looking through the vegetation. Use warm filtered daylight and a dark earthy atmosphere. No people, buildings or other vehicles.

presets.title: Alpine Hairpin Huracán
presets.summary: A yellow supercar carves through a high late-autumn mountain bend.
presets.prompt: A yellow Lamborghini Huracán driving around a tight hairpin bend on a high alpine mountain road during late autumn. Show the car from an elevated rear three-quarter angle as it follows the lower section of the curve toward the left. Give the Lamborghini black wheels, dark rear vents, a fixed rear wing, black racing stripes and a large black number 21 printed on the door. Keep the car relatively small within a very wide composition to emphasize the scale of the mountain pass. The cracked grey asphalt forms a dramatic switchback, with one road descending across the lower-left side and another climbing steeply toward the upper-right. Border the road with low stone barriers, rough stone retaining walls, white edge markings and a simple black-and-white arrow sign. Surround the pass with dark evergreen trees and golden alpine larches. In the distance, a massive rocky mountain rises above the valley, its upper slopes lightly covered with snow and partially wrapped in low clouds. No people or additional cars.

presets.title: Wildflower Knight Rest
presets.summary: A solitary armored traveler pauses quietly in tall golden grass.
presets.prompt: A solitary medieval knight sits quietly in a meadow of tall golden grass and scattered pink wildflowers, seen from behind and slightly from the side. He wears dark, weathered plate armor, a closed helmet, and a long black cloak spread across the ground. The hilt of a sword rises above his shoulder. He looks across a vast valley toward a distant Gothic castle standing on a steep rocky hill on the right side of the scene. The castle has narrow towers, sharp spires, and a dark silhouette against the setting sun. The horizon glows with orange, red, and soft pink light, while massive charcoal storm clouds cover the upper sky. Warm sunset light touches the edges of the grass and the knight’s armor. Distant mountains and forests dissolve into atmospheric haze. A quiet, reflective dark-fantasy scene with a wide landscape composition and a strong contrast between the glowing horizon and the shadowed foreground.

presets.title: Cloud Sea Castle
presets.summary: A pale fairy-tale fortress crowns a steep island above endless clouds.
presets.prompt: A magnificent fairy-tale castle rises from the top of a steep rocky island surrounded by an endless sea of clouds. The castle stands in the center of the composition, built from pale stone with many tall towers, slender turrets, pointed dark-blue roofs, arched bridges, and glowing amber windows. Small green trees and shrubs grow along the lower cliffs of the island. Beneath the clouds, a perfectly still reflective surface mirrors the entire castle, the island, and the surrounding sky. Huge white cumulus clouds frame the castle from both sides. Above them stretches a deep blue celestial sky filled with stars, glowing nebula clouds, delicate streaks of light, and a large crescent moon near the upper right. The warm light of the castle contrasts with the cool blue night. A peaceful, majestic fantasy atmosphere with a balanced, nearly symmetrical composition and a sense of floating high above the world.

presets.title: Mist Basin Warrior
presets.summary: A tiny cloaked figure crosses shallow water beneath a vast forest.
presets.prompt: A lone warrior in a dark hooded cloak walks through shallow water in a vast misty forest basin. He is seen from behind and appears very small compared with the environment. In one hand he carries a narrow sword glowing with warm orange light, creating a small reflection on the wet ground. Directly ahead stands a colossal ancient tree formation, larger than a mountain, with a massive twisted trunk and enormous branch-like roots extending outward like the horns or limbs of a sleeping mythical creature. Its entire surface is covered with thick green moss, hanging vines, wet plants, and patches of dark bark. Small cracks inside the trunk glow faintly with red and orange light, suggesting hidden fire or ancient energy. Low fog drifts across the swamp, while towering cliffs or giant tree trunks disappear into the blue haze in the background. Cold cyan light filters down from above, creating an eerie, mysterious fantasy world built around scale, silence, and discovery.

presets.title: Sunset Black Dragon
presets.summary: An enormous dark dragon spans a turbulent fire-colored sky.
presets.prompt: A gigantic black dragon flies through a turbulent sky during a fiery sunset. The dragon is shown in side profile across the center of the scene, with its enormous wings fully extended, sharp spines running along its neck and back, powerful legs hanging beneath its body, and a long curved tail trailing through the clouds. Its scales and wing membranes are almost black, with faint orange reflections and glowing sparks scattered across its body. On the left, the setting sun floods the sky with brilliant yellow, orange, and crimson light. On the right, the atmosphere becomes dark purple and deep blue beneath heavy storm clouds. Jagged mountain peaks rise through the mist below, while glowing fires, molten cracks, and drifting embers appear across the distant landscape. Clouds wrap around the dragon’s body and wings, making it feel as though it is emerging from a storm. A dramatic fantasy scene with strong warm and cool color contrast, immense scale, and a sweeping panoramic composition.

presets.title: Moonlit Frozen Titan
presets.summary: A colossal frozen figure dominates an empty blue-white wasteland.
presets.prompt: A vast frozen wasteland stretches beneath a cold blue sky and an enormous pale full moon. In the distance, a colossal frozen titan sits motionless on a snow-covered mountain, dominating the entire landscape. The giant has a bowed head, broad shoulders, one raised knee, and heavy arms resting against its body. Its face, long hair, and beard are buried beneath thick layers of ice, snow, and hanging icicles. The lower part of its body appears fused with the rocky mountain, as though it has remained frozen there for thousands of years. Across the bottom of the scene, a long line of tiny cloaked travelers moves in single file through the snow, their dark silhouettes emphasizing the impossible size of the titan. Wind carries fine snow across rolling dunes, ridges, and patches of exposed frozen ground. Pale mist softens the distant horizon. The entire scene uses muted blue, white, and gray tones, creating a lonely, ancient, and solemn fantasy atmosphere with a wide composition and an overwhelming sense of scale.

presets.title: Enchanted Forest Serpent
presets.summary: A gigantic blue-black serpent glides through mist and reflected trees.
presets.prompt: A gigantic mystical serpent glides through a dark enchanted forest filled with mist and shallow water. The creature has a long, elegant, snake-like body with deep blue and black scales, subtle glowing patterns across its skin, and small sharp spines running along its back. Its body curves in a dramatic loop across the scene, with the head lowered near the glowing ground and the tail rising high in the background. Bright electric-blue magical energy swirls around the serpent in thin luminous lines, sparks, and floating particles, as if the creature is generating living light. Tall tree trunks fade into a cold blue fog, creating depth and a dreamlike atmosphere. The forest floor is wet and reflective, mirroring the glowing light and parts of the serpent’s body. Small patches of warm golden light in the undergrowth contrast with the dominant icy blue tones. A moody fantasy scene with a mysterious, powerful, ancient spirit-creature in a magical woodland.

presets.title: Swamp Water Wraith
presets.summary: A mysterious woman stands motionless in a dark, mirror-still marsh.
presets.prompt: A haunting dark-fantasy scene of a mysterious woman standing chest-deep in still swamp water. She faces forward in the center of the composition, almost motionless, with long wet black hair hanging over her face and shoulders in tangled strands. Her expression is cold, distant, and unsettling, with pale skin partly hidden in shadow. She wears a soaked, tattered, semi-transparent dark garment clinging to her arms and body, the fabric trailing into the water. Her arms extend outward slightly, creating a ritual-like or ghostly pose. The water around her is calm with soft ripples spreading outward. Thick gray mist covers the lake and background, obscuring the horizon and making the setting feel empty and isolated. The lighting is dim, cold, and desaturated, with blue-gray tones and a faint glow behind the fog. A cinematic horror-fantasy atmosphere focused on stillness, dread, and eerie supernatural presence.

presets.title: Underground Skull Lagoon
presets.summary: A tiny boat drifts toward a colossal stone skull inside a hidden cavern.
presets.prompt: A vast hidden cavern opens onto a calm underground lagoon where a tiny wooden boat drifts across reflective water. In the background, an enormous ancient stone skull is carved into the rock face, partially overgrown with moss, vines, and tropical plants. The skull is monumental in scale, with hollow eye sockets and an open mouth, and its surface is decorated with faded colorful patterns and weathered markings, giving it the feeling of a forgotten sacred monument. Thin waterfalls pour down from above and cascade over the skull and surrounding cliffs, filling the cave with mist and soft light. Sunbeams filter through openings high in the cavern roof, illuminating the skull and parts of the water while the cave edges remain dark. In the foreground and middle distance, the water is smooth and glassy, reflecting the waterfalls, stone, and greenery. A lone person sits in the small boat, emphasizing the huge scale of the cavern and the monument. A mysterious adventure-fantasy scene with a quiet, sacred, lost-world atmosphere.

presets.title: Indoor Gridiron Catch
presets.summary: A powerful receiver drives through a packed indoor stadium.
presets.prompt: A field-level sports photograph of a professional American football game inside a packed indoor stadium. A powerful receiver in a black helmet, black jersey with red and white accents, white pants and black gloves is completely airborne, his body stretched horizontally above two defenders. He holds the football securely in one raised hand high above his helmet while his other arm reaches toward the turf. One defender in a silver helmet, white jersey and pale blue pants dives low across the foreground, almost parallel to the ground. A second defender approaches from the right, extending an arm toward the receiver. The orange goal-line pylon appears at the bottom edge of the frame. Bright green turf, blurred players on the sideline, a glowing red LED ribbon and a crowded stadium fill the background.
